<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
<meta name="referrer" content="same-origin">
<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; script-src 'sha256-Vrn9N5KCkmpfQr/g4sZ/HwW06UNLPBVhy7fXbGAFzXo='; style-src 'sha256-9w6/4QEdlNmsWNHVngaXi3GF/9lCJ3Kbz2iPkrfnP1w='; img-src data: 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'; connect-src 'self'">
<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="data:image/svg+xml;base64,">
<title>Phone · caracole · Phone</title>
<style>
:root {
  color-scheme: light dark;
  --bg: #f6f5f1;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --raised: #f1efea;
  --text: #1d1c1a;
  --muted: #645f57;
  --border: #e3dfd6;
  --border-strong: #cdc7bb;
  /* A glyph's quiet colour (what a song's line holds): below --muted, yet 3:1 or more against every background, as a
     graphic needs (WCAG 1.4.11); never a text's. */
  --faint: #857f74;
  --control-edge: #8d877c;
  --accent: #b4441e;
  --accent-hover: #9a3915;
  --on-accent: #ffffff;
  /* A second accent, an artist's name over their songs: umber, a warm brown of the rust's family, which sits on the
     paper as the buttons do. Contrast 7.0:1 on --raised, 8.0:1 on --surface; in the dark, 7.9:1 and 9.1:1. */
  --artist: #7a4219;
  --focus: #1f6feb;
  --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(31 30 28 / 6%), 0 6px 18px rgb(31 30 28 / 5%);
  /* A song opened in the library, a card over the list, and what is sunk in it (its chips, its tiles' downloads). */
  --card: #faf9f6;
  --sunk: #f3f1ec;
  --card-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgb(31 30 28 / 12%);
  --found: #1d6b43; --found-bg: #def1e5;
  --wanted: #7a4c00; --wanted-bg: #fbeed2;
  --ignored: #5c5c5c; --ignored-bg: #ebebeb;
  --review: #5b34a8; --review-bg: #ece4fa;
  --auto: #0e5c6e; --auto-bg: #dbf0f5;
  --failed: #a3261b; --failed-bg: #fbe1dd;
  /* How much of --accent washes a song you have fetched, among a search's results (rows.css). */
  --have-tint: 9%;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --bg: #131312;
    --surface: #1c1b1a;
    --raised: #282725;
    --text: #edebe7;
    --muted: #aaa59c;
    --border: #34322f;
    --border-strong: #4b4844;
    --faint: #7d786f;
    --control-edge: #7a756e;
    --accent: #f0895c;
    --accent-hover: #f5a47f;
    --on-accent: #1b0e07;
    --artist: #e3b48a;
    --focus: #6ea8fe;
    --shadow: none;
    --card: #211f1e;
    --sunk: #181716;
    --card-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / 28%);
    --found: #83d6a6; --found-bg: #133222;
    --wanted: #f2c46e; --wanted-bg: #36290d;
    --ignored: #b8b8b8; --ignored-bg: #2d2d2d;
    --review: #c6adff; --review-bg: #2b2047;
    --auto: #8fd6e8; --auto-bg: #102f37;
    --failed: #ff9d92; --failed-bg: #3d1713;
    --have-tint: 15%;
  }
}
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; text-size-adjust: 100%; }
body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  font: 16px/1.45 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial,
    "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif;
}
a { color: inherit; }
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
code { font: .9em ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--raised); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.page { max-width: 1320px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 16px 56px; }
.masthead { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px 16px;
  padding: 20px 0 8px; }
.masthead h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.6rem; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.015em; }
.app { margin: 0 0 4px; color: var(--accent); font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .08em;
  line-height: 1.2; text-transform: uppercase; }
.app a { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 0; text-decoration: none; }
@media (hover: hover) { .app a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } }
.app .mark { flex: none; width: auto; height: 1.5em; }
.links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.navlink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; }
.navlink:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.navlink .n { min-width: 22px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent);
  font-size: .78rem; line-height: 22px; text-align: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
/* The header of the pages caracole serve writes itself (web/top.py): the "¿" and the name, which lead home, the page's
   title after them, its links at the end, all one line; a muted line under it for what the page is of. On a phone the
   mark alone leads, a thumb's target. */
.top { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 12px; padding: 14px 0 6px; }
.top .app { display: inline-flex; flex: none; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin: 0; text-decoration: none; }
@media (hover: hover) { .top .app:hover .word { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } }
.top .sep { flex: none; color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1; }
.top h1 { flex: 0 1 auto; min-width: 0; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1.25;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.top .links { flex: none; margin-left: auto; }
.top .navlink { padding: 0 14px; font-size: .92rem; }
.top-sub { margin: 0 0 4px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .92rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
/* Which library the page shows (library_name.py): its name after caracole's, muted, behind a thin rule, and the badge
   of a library that isn't the usual one ("Scratch library", "Demo") after it, a pill in --wanted's colours with a
   dashed edge. On a phone, with a badge, the two are a line of their own under the header; with none, the name is in
   the tab's title alone. */
.libname { display: inline-flex; flex: 0 1 auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; margin: 0;
  padding-left: 12px; border-left: 1px solid var(--border-strong); color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem;
  font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: normal; line-height: 1.3; text-transform: none; }
.libname .name { min-width: 0; max-width: 18em; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.libname .scratch { flex: none; padding: 1px 9px; border: 1px dashed currentColor; border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--wanted); background: var(--wanted-bg); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .06em;
  line-height: 1.5; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }
@media (max-width: 559px) {
  .top .app .word, .top .libname:not(:has(.scratch)) { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px;
    overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }
  .top .libname { order: 1; flex-basis: 100%; padding-left: 0; border-left: 0; }
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .top .app { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; justify-content: center; }
}
.btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 13px;
  border-radius: 11px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--raised); color: var(--text); font: inherit;
  font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 550; text-decoration: none; overflow-wrap: anywhere; cursor: pointer; }
.btn:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.btn:disabled { color: var(--muted); border-style: dashed; cursor: default; }
.btn.primary { min-height: 44px; background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent);
  font-weight: 650; }
.btn.primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); border-color: var(--accent-hover); }
.btn.small { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 11px; font-size: .85rem; }
.badge { padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; }
.badge.found, .badge.done { color: var(--found); background: var(--found-bg); }
.badge.wanted, .badge.queued, .badge.running { color: var(--wanted); background: var(--wanted-bg); }
.badge.ignored { color: var(--ignored); background: var(--ignored-bg); }
.badge.review { color: var(--review); background: var(--review-bg); }
.badge.auto { color: var(--auto); background: var(--auto-bg); }
.badge.failed { color: var(--failed); background: var(--failed-bg); }
.f { display: grid; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600; }
.f em { font-style: normal; font-weight: 500; }
.f input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--control-edge);
  background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; }
.f input:focus { border-color: var(--focus); outline: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 30%, transparent); }
.footer { margin-top: 40px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; }
.visually-hidden { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
  white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }
@media (min-width: 720px) {
  .page { padding: 0 24px 64px; }
  .masthead { padding-top: 32px; }
  .masthead h1 { font-size: 2.1rem; }
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .btn, .btn.small { min-height: 44px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .btn, .navlink { transition: background-color .12s, border-color .12s; }
}

.picker { min-width: 0; }
.picker > summary ~ * { margin-top: 8px; }
.picker > summary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; list-style: none;
  cursor: pointer; }
.picker > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.picker > summary:not(.btn) { min-height: 32px; color: var(--review); font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 650; }
.picker > summary:not(.btn)::before { content: "›"; display: inline-block; width: 1em; font-size: 1.15rem;
  line-height: 1; text-align: center; }
.picker[open] > summary:not(.btn)::before { transform: rotate(90deg); }
.picker > summary.btn { border-color: var(--review); color: var(--review); background: var(--review-bg); }
.picker-n { margin-left: .35em; font-weight: 500; }
.pick-form { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin: 0; }
.choices { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; list-style: none; }
.choices legend { margin: 0 0 6px; padding: 0; font-size: .92rem; font-weight: 650; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.choice { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; padding: 4px 8px 4px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--raised); }
.choice:has(input:checked) { border-color: var(--accent); }
.choice-pick { display: flex; flex: 1; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; }
label.choice-pick { cursor: pointer; }
.choice-pick input { flex: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--accent); }
.choice-text { display: grid; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; padding: 4px 0; }
.choice-name { font-size: .92rem; font-weight: 600; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.choice-why { color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.choice-link { flex: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px;
  border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); font-size: .82rem;
  font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; }
.choice-link:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.pick-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 20px; }
.pick-check { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer; }
.pick-check input { width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--accent); }
.pick-hint { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .82rem; }
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .picker > summary:not(.btn), .choice-link { min-height: 44px; }
}

/* Until the page's scripts have drawn it (drawn.js), it waits unseen: painted before, as a slow machine may paint it,
   its list would be empty, the request form open under the bar and the library shown though you left the Songbooks
   tab open, and all of it would move once they have run. Should they never get that far, it shows after two seconds;
   with no script at all, at once. */
@media (scripting: enabled) {
  body.drawing .page { visibility: hidden; animation: drawn 0s 2s forwards; }
}
@keyframes drawn { to { visibility: visible; } }
.summary { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
/* The library's header, one line: caracole, the tabs (Library, Songbooks and, served, Requests), and what needs
   attention (wanted songs) at its end. Placed by area, so that a number changing its width (a tab's count) moves
   nothing; on a phone the numbers, when there are any, are a line of their own. */
.masthead.lib { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  grid-template-areas: "app name tabs sum"; align-items: center; gap: 4px 14px; padding: 12px 0 0; }
.masthead.lib .app { grid-area: app; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; }
/* The library's name, and a badge for one that isn't the usual library (base.css's .libname): on a phone, the badge
   and the name a line of their own under the tabs, and with no badge, the name in the tab's title alone. */
.masthead.lib .libname { grid-area: name; }
@media (max-width: 719px) {
  .masthead.lib .libname { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden;
    clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }
  .masthead.lib:has(.scratch) { grid-template-areas: "app tabs" "name name" "sum sum"; }
  .masthead.lib .libname:has(.scratch) { position: static; justify-self: start; width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0;
    padding-left: 0; border-left: 0; overflow: visible; clip: auto; }
}
.masthead.lib .tabs { grid-area: tabs; min-width: 0; margin: 0; border-bottom: 0; }
.masthead.lib .summary { grid-area: sum; justify-self: end; gap: 8px; margin: 0; }
.masthead.lib .summary:empty { display: none; }
/* The page's tabs, in the masthead (tabs.js): each shows its panel; a count beside its name (songbooks, requests that
   wait or run), none when there are none. */
.tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; margin: 2px 0 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.tab { display: inline-flex; flex: none; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 36px; margin-bottom: -1px;
  padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; background: none; color: var(--muted); font: inherit;
  font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; }
.tab:hover { color: var(--text); }
.tab[aria-selected="true"] { border-bottom-color: var(--accent); color: var(--text); }
.tab .n { min-width: 20px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--raised); color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .75rem; line-height: 20px; text-align: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.tab .n:empty { display: none; }
.stat { padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--raised); color: var(--muted); font-size: .82rem;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.stat b { color: var(--text); font-weight: 650; }
.request { margin: 8px 0 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface); }
.request > summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 650; list-style: none; }
.request > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.plus { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1; }
.plus span { display: inline-block; }
.request[open] > summary .plus span { transform: rotate(45deg); }  /* the + turns into a ×, the square stays */
.request-form { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 0 16px 16px; }
.fields { display: grid; gap: 12px; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 220px), 1fr)); }
.request-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 20px; }
.check { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
.check input { width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--accent); }
.hint { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; }
/* Kept at the top, side to side across the page, with an edge once the page scrolls under it (.stuck). */
.searchbar { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 2; margin: 0 -16px; padding: 10px 16px 8px; background: var(--bg); }
.searchbar.stuck { box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--border-strong), 0 8px 16px -10px rgb(0 0 0 / 35%); }
.bar-edge { height: 0; }
.field { position: relative; }
.field input {
  width: 100%; height: 46px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none;
}
.field input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); opacity: 1; }
.field input:not(:placeholder-shown) { padding-right: 48px; }  /* room for the clear button */
.field input::-webkit-search-cancel-button { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; }
.field input:focus { border-color: var(--focus); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 30%, transparent); }
.clear { position: absolute; top: 1px; right: 1px; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px;
  background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; }
.bar-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.bar-row .field { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
/* One line, its height kept: what typing and Enter do, or how the search of the sites goes. */
.bar-status:empty { min-height: 0; margin: 0; }
.bar-status { min-height: 1.35em; margin: 6px 2px 0; overflow: hidden; color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem;
  line-height: 1.35; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
/* Under the box: what each site found, its mark and its count (rows.css .counts-row), then the words, one line cut
   short, after the marks or on the next line; at rest, nothing, and no room kept. */
.bar-said { min-height: 22px; margin: 6px 2px 0; }
.bar-said:has(> .counts[hidden]):has(> .bar-status:empty) { min-height: 0; margin: 0; }
.bar-said > .bar-status { flex: 1 1 12rem; margin: 0; }
.searching-all .toolbar, .searching-all .jump, .searching-all .count, .searching-all .list { display: none; }
.waiting-sites .results .request, .waiting-sites .footer { display: none; }
/* A search that found nothing on the sites has its Request in its line: the form shows only once that opens it. */
.results.missed .request:not([open]) { display: none; }
.results-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px 12px; margin: 4px 0 0; }
/* What the filters (the Filter panel's, an artist's) leave of your songs, hidden with the toolbar while the sites'
   results show: "Your songs here: wanted", and Show all of yours. */
.filtered { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 10px; margin: 0; color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .85rem; }
.all-mine { margin: 10px 0 0; }
/* The list showing one progression's songs alone (#prog=): "Songs with I–V–vi–IV, the pop progression · Show all";
   in the sites' results, how many of your songs play the progression typed, with Show them. */
.prog-filter { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 10px; margin: 10px 0 0; color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .85rem; }
.searching-all .prog-filter { display: none; }
.prog-found { margin: 10px 0 0; }
/* The sites' results: one box of groups, as the list's, your songs and the indexes' under each artist's header, then
   the artist's foot: "+ 57 more by Estopa", or the offer to read their page on LaCuerda. */
#found > .groups { margin-top: 10px; }
.group-tail { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 12px; padding: 2px 4px 4px 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
.group-tail .read-page { margin: 2px 0; }
.btn.more-by { min-height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border-color: transparent; background: transparent;
  color: var(--accent); font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 650; }
.btn.more-by:hover { border-color: var(--border); background: var(--raised); }
/* An artist a typo may have meant: their songs, in the artist's accent, as their name over them. */
.btn.their-songs { color: var(--artist); }
.their-arrow { margin-left: 5px; }
.badge.removed { color: var(--ignored); background: var(--ignored-bg); }
.results .request { margin-top: 20px; }
.file-answer { display: grid; gap: 8px; max-width: 72ch; margin: 6px 0 12px; padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface); font-size: .92rem; }
.file-answer p { margin: 0; }
.command { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.command code { flex: 1 1 240px; padding: 8px 10px; user-select: all; }
.empty + .btn.primary { margin-top: 4px; }
.jump { display: flex; gap: 2px; margin: 10px 0 0; padding: 2px 0; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; }
.jump::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.jump button { flex: none; min-width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px;
  background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: inherit; font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; }
.jump button:hover { background: var(--raised); color: var(--text); }
.count { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; }
.count[hidden] { display: none; }

.card-label { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em;
  text-transform: uppercase; }
.card-label em { margin-left: 8px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; }

/* What you play from it: a tile each, its body opening what it holds, its chips its versions per source, its formats
   downloads along its foot; every one alike, its glyph in the accent as its line's button has it, none first, an auto
   sheet's in its own colour. More than one version: a small stack under it. */
.tiles { position: relative; z-index: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(15.5rem, 1fr));
  align-items: start; gap: 16px 12px; }
.tile { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); }
.tile-open { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 38px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px 12px 10px; border-radius: 11px 11px 0 0; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
.tile-open:hover .tile-name { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.tile-ico { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--raised);
  color: var(--accent); }
.tile-ico svg.glyph { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
.tile-words { display: grid; min-width: 0; }
.tile-name { font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.3; }
.tile-from { overflow: hidden; color: var(--muted); font-size: .78rem; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.tile-go { display: grid; color: var(--muted); }
.tile-go svg.glyph { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.tile.auto { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--auto) 60%, transparent); }
.tile.auto .tile-ico { color: var(--auto); }
.tile.auto .tile-go { color: var(--auto); }
.tile.stack::before, .tile.stack::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 10px; right: 10px; bottom: -5px;
  z-index: -1; height: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-top: 0; border-radius: 0 0 11px 11px;
  background: var(--sunk); }
.tile.stack::after { left: 20px; right: 20px; bottom: -9px; background: var(--card); }
.tile-versions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 12px 10px; }
.tile-versions .lead { min-width: 3.6rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: .76rem; font-weight: 650; }
.vchip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 28px; margin: 0; padding: 0 8px 0 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--sunk); color: var(--text); font: inherit;
  font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; }
.vchip .n { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.vchip svg.glyph { width: 14px; height: 14px; color: var(--muted); }
.vchip:hover { border-color: var(--control-edge); }
.vchip[aria-expanded="true"] { border-color: var(--accent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 13%, transparent); }
.vchip[aria-expanded="true"] svg.glyph { transform: rotate(180deg); color: var(--accent); }
.vchip.one { color: var(--muted); border-style: dashed; cursor: default; }
.tile-downloads { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 14px; margin-top: auto; padding: 8px 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0 0 11px 11px; background: var(--sunk); }
.dl { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; }
.dl:hover { color: var(--text); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }
.dl svg.glyph { flex: none; width: 13px; height: 13px; }

/* One source's versions, opened from its chip: under the row of tiles that holds its tile, its pointer over that tile
   (card.js sets --point), a row a version. */
.drawer { position: relative; grid-column: 1 / -1; margin-top: -4px; border: 1px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); }
.drawer::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -7px; left: calc(var(--point, 48px) - 6px); width: 12px;
  height: 12px; transform: rotate(45deg); border-top: 1px solid var(--accent); border-left: 1px solid var(--accent);
  background: var(--surface); }
.drawer-head { position: relative; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px 10px;
  min-height: 46px; padding: 8px 48px 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.drawer-what { margin: 0; font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 650; }
.drawer-said { color: var(--muted); font-size: .84rem; }
.drawer-head form { margin: 0; }
.drawer-head .pin-note { flex: 1 1 100%; margin: 0; color: var(--review); font-size: .84rem; }
.drawer-close { position: absolute; top: 7px; right: 8px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px;
  height: 30px; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent;
  color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; }
.drawer-close:hover { border-color: var(--border); background: var(--raised); color: var(--text); }
.drawer-close svg.glyph { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.vrows { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.vrow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: "ver stars" "note note" "act act";
  align-items: center; gap: 4px 12px; min-height: 46px; padding: 8px 12px; }
.vrow + .vrow { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
.vrow .ver { grid-area: ver; font-weight: 650; }
.vrow .stars { grid-area: stars; color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.vrow .stars b { color: var(--wanted); font-weight: 650; }
.vrow .note { grid-area: note; min-width: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .84rem; }
.vrow .note b { color: var(--found); font-weight: 600; }
.vrow .note .dl { margin-right: 14px; }
.vrow .note:empty { display: none; }
.vbtns { grid-area: act; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.vbtns form { margin: 0; }
.vrow .btn { min-height: 30px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 600; }
.vrow .btn.go { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent); background: transparent;
  color: var(--accent); }
.inuse { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; min-height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--found-bg); color: var(--found); font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 700; }
.inuse svg.glyph { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.vrow.cur { background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--found) 9%, transparent), transparent 60%); }
.vrow.gone .ver { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; }
.drawer-rest { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 12px; padding: 10px 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; }
.drawer-rest form { margin: 0; }
@media (max-width: 719px) {  /* on a phone the source's mark, beside what it lists, its counts under that */
  .drawer-head { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 2px 10px; }
  .drawer-head > :not(.source):not(.drawer-what) { grid-column: 2; justify-self: start; }
}
@media (min-width: 720px) {
  .vrow { grid-template-columns: 5.5rem 9.5rem minmax(0, 1fr) auto; grid-template-areas: "ver stars note act"; }
  .vrow .note { overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .vbtns { justify-content: flex-end; }
}

/* Which sites have it (card.js sitesOf): its label, then a mark a site, as a search's line shows a site's song's. */
.card-sites { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px 12px; }
.card-sites .card-label { margin: 0; }

/* Its progressions: chips with a search's mark, which find your songs that play one, unlike a file or an action. */
.progs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.prog { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 32px; margin: 0; padding: 0 12px 0 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--sunk); color: var(--text); font: inherit;
  font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 550; cursor: pointer; }
.prog:hover { border-color: var(--control-edge); }
.prog svg.glyph { flex: none; width: 14px; height: 14px; color: var(--artist); }
.prog-text { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.prog { max-width: 16rem; }
.progs-more { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px dashed var(--border-strong); border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: var(--muted);
  font: inherit; font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; }
.progs-more:hover { color: var(--text); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }
.find-elsewhere { display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.find-elsewhere .card-label { margin: 0; }
.find-elsewhere .subhead { margin: 0 0 4px; }

/* Its foot: what changes the song, then at the far end info.json, quiet, and Remove, red from the start but outlined,
   never the main thing to do. */
.line:not(.hit) > .line-panel > .foot { flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding-top: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
.foot .btn svg.glyph { flex: none; width: 16px; height: 16px; margin-right: 7px; color: var(--muted); }
/* "⋯", at the foot's far end: info.json and Remove, in a menu that opens upward over the card. */
.foot-more { position: relative; margin-left: auto; }
.foot-more > summary { list-style: none; }
.foot-more > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.foot-more-btn { min-width: 38px; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--muted); }
.foot-more[open] > .foot-more-btn { border-color: var(--control-edge); background: var(--raised); color: var(--text); }
.foot-menu { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: calc(100% + 6px); z-index: 3; display: grid; gap: 4px; min-width: 12.5rem;
  padding: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface);
  box-shadow: var(--pop-shadow); }
.foot-menu form { margin: 0; }
.foot-menu .btn, .foot-menu .info-file { justify-content: flex-start; width: 100%; }
.info-file { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 6px; }
.info-file svg.glyph { width: 15px; height: 15px; margin-right: 4px; }
.btn.remove { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--failed) 45%, transparent); background: transparent;
  color: var(--failed); }
.btn.remove svg.glyph { color: var(--failed); }
.btn.remove:hover { border-color: var(--failed); background: var(--failed-bg); }

/* From 720 px what you play from is a row each, not a grid of tiles: its name and version, the source it came from (its
   mark and name, which opens that source's versions), its formats at the end, wrapping where the row is too narrow
   for them all (a sheet's PDF exports). A phone keeps the tile. */
@media (min-width: 720px) {
  .tiles { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 8px; }
  .tile { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 4px 16px; }
  .tile-open { flex: 1 1 auto; padding: 8px 4px 8px 12px; border-radius: 11px 0 0 11px; }
  .tile-versions { flex: none; padding: 0; }
  .tile-downloads { flex: 0 1 auto; justify-content: flex-end; min-width: 0; margin: 0 12px 0 0; padding: 0; border: 0;
    border-radius: 0; background: none; }
}

/* A thumb's targets: every chip, download, button and close of the card, 44 px. */
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .vchip, .dl, .prog, .vrow .btn, .inuse, .info-file, .progs-more { min-height: 44px; }
  .foot-more-btn { min-width: 44px; }
  .dl { min-width: 44px; justify-content: center; }
  .drawer-head { padding-right: 60px; }
  .drawer-close { top: 1px; width: 44px; height: 44px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .vchip svg.glyph { transition: transform .15s; }
}

/* A request's steps (web/outcome.py's), as chips: the Requests tab's running card, and on the library page a song's
   line, or a search result's row, while its lookup runs (library.js). Those done ticked in the found colour, the one
   that runs lit, those to come grey, a failed one red; a plain one, over and no failure ("Match: not on UG"), dashed
   and muted. The site a step names is bold: "Sheet LaCuerda". */
.step-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.step-chip { min-width: 0; padding: 2px 9px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--raised);
  color: var(--muted); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.step-chip b { font-weight: 750; }
.step-chip.done { color: var(--found); background: var(--found-bg); }
.step-chip.running { border-color: var(--auto); color: var(--auto); background: var(--auto-bg); font-weight: 750; }
.step-chip.failed { color: var(--failed); background: var(--failed-bg); }
.step-chip.plain { border: 1px dashed var(--control-edge); background: transparent; }
.list section.artist, .list .line, .requested .line { scroll-margin-top: 108px; }  /* below the bar kept at the top */
@media (min-width: 720px) {
  .jump { flex-wrap: wrap; overflow: visible; }
  .searchbar { margin: 0 -24px; padding: 12px 24px 8px; }
  .masthead.lib { padding-top: 18px; }
}
/* A thumb's targets: the tabs, the letters and "+ N more" (the toolbar's and the Filter panel's are filter.css's).
   Every .btn has its 44 px from BASE_STYLE, and a line's, its chevron and an artist's name theirs from ROWS_STYLE. */
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .tab, .btn.more-by { min-height: 44px; }
  .tab { min-width: 44px; justify-content: center; }  /* Sites, the shortest name */
  .progress .undo { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; }
  .jump button { min-width: 44px; height: 44px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .plus span { transition: transform .15s; }
  .progress[data-tone="running"]::before { animation: pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
}
@keyframes pulse { 50% { opacity: .25; } }
/* The Songbooks tab: the songbooks as lines, then the one opened as a set list; side by side from 900px, and on a
   phone one at a time, the set list with its way back to the list. */
.books { padding-top: 10px; }
.books-in { display: grid; gap: 12px; align-items: start; }
@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .books-in { grid-template-columns: minmax(13rem, 18rem) minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .book-back { display: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 899px) {
  .books-in.has-book > .book-list { display: none; }
  .book-back { justify-self: start; margin: 0 0 6px -4px; }
}
.book-list { display: grid; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
.book-lines { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow); overflow: hidden; }
.book-lines > li + li { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
.book-line { display: grid; width: 100%; min-height: 40px; margin: 0; padding: 4px 12px; border: 0; background: none;
  color: var(--text); font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
button.book-line:hover { background: var(--raised); }
.book-line[aria-current="true"] { background: var(--raised); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent); }
.book-name { font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.3; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.book-meta { color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; line-height: 1.35; }
.book-line.gone .book-name { color: var(--muted); }
.new-book { justify-self: start; }
.sb-error { margin: 0; color: var(--failed); font-weight: 600; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.book { display: grid; min-width: 0; padding: 10px 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.book-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 2px 12px; }
.book-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.3; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.book-head h2:focus { outline: none; }
.book-head .book-meta { font-size: .85rem; }
.book.gone { align-content: start; }  /* kept as tall as it was: nothing under it moves */
.book.gone h2 { color: var(--muted); }
/* How its changes go, on one line kept for it: nothing under it moves when it speaks. */
.book-status { min-height: 1.45em; margin: 2px 0 4px; font-size: .85rem; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap;
  text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.book-status:empty::before { display: none; }
.book-files { align-items: center; margin: 0 0 8px; }
.book-files form { margin: 0; }
.book-files .hint { margin: 0; }
.get-missing.spent { visibility: hidden; }
/* The set list: a song a line, as dense as the library's with a mouse; on a phone two lines a song, its grip and
   its × a thumb's target each. Every column but the title's and the artist's keeps its width, so that a song's
   chip or button saying something else moves nothing beside it. */
.set { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; }
.set-line { --grip: 26px; --out: 26px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: var(--grip) minmax(0, 1fr) auto var(--out);
  grid-template-areas: "grip name act out" "grip meta meta meta"; align-items: center; gap: 0 6px; min-width: 0;
  padding: 2px 4px 3px 2px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); }
.set-line:first-child { border-top: 0; border-radius: 9px 9px 0 0; }
.set-line:last-child { border-radius: 0 0 9px 9px; }
.set-line:only-child { border-radius: 9px; }
.book.read-only .set-line { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: "name" "meta";
  padding-left: 10px; }
.grip { grid-area: grip; align-self: stretch; display: grid; place-items: center; width: var(--grip); min-height: 24px;
  padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: none; color: var(--muted); font: inherit; font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1; cursor: grab; touch-action: none; -webkit-user-select: none; user-select: none; }
.grip:hover { background: var(--raised); color: var(--text); }
.grip:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .4; }
.set-name { grid-area: name; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
.set-n { flex: none; min-width: 2ch; color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; text-align: right;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.set-title { display: flex; align-items: center; min-width: 0; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
a.set-title:hover h3 { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
/* A song's Guitar Pro mark, after its title: a file caracole keeps, solid in the accent. No taller than the line's
   other controls; a thumb's target on a touch screen. */
.set-gp { flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; margin-left: -4px;
  border-radius: 6px; color: var(--accent); }
.set-gp svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: currentColor; }
.set-gp:hover { background: var(--raised); }
.set-gp:focus-visible { outline-offset: -1px; }  /* clear of the title */
.set-line h3 { min-width: 0; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3;
  white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.set-meta { grid-area: meta; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px 8px; min-width: 0; }
.set-by { flex: 1 1 3rem; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; color: var(--muted); font-size: .82rem; white-space: nowrap;
  text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.set-plays { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 11rem; min-width: 0; min-height: 24px; }
.plays { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; max-width: 100%; min-height: 24px; padding: 0 9px; overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: inherit;
  font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
span.plays { border-color: transparent; background: var(--raised); }
button.plays { cursor: pointer; }
button.plays:hover, button.plays[aria-expanded="true"] { border-color: var(--accent); }
.plays.set { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }  /* a setting of the songbook's own */
.plays.pending { color: var(--muted); }
.set-plays .badge { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.set-act { grid-area: act; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; min-width: 0; }
.set-act .btn { min-height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border-color: transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent;
  color: var(--accent); font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; }
.set-act .btn:hover { border-color: var(--border); background: var(--raised); }
.set-act .btn:disabled { color: var(--muted); }
.set-out { grid-area: out; display: grid; place-items: center; width: var(--out); height: 24px; padding: 0; border: 0;
  border-radius: 8px; background: none; color: var(--muted); font: inherit; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1;
  cursor: pointer; }
.set-out:hover { background: var(--raised); color: var(--failed); }
.set-line > .progress { grid-column: 2 / -1; overflow: hidden; font-size: .82rem; white-space: nowrap;
  text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.set-line.leaving, .set-line.pending { color: var(--muted); }
.set-line.leaving h3, .set-line.pending h3 { color: var(--muted); }
.set-line.gone { grid-template-columns: var(--grip) minmax(0, 1fr) auto; grid-template-areas: "grip name act";
  color: var(--muted); }
.set-line.gone h3 { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: line-through; }
.set-gone { grid-area: act; padding-right: 6px; font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 600; }
/* A song dragged: over the others, which make room for it as it passes. */
.set-line.dragging { position: relative; z-index: 1; background: var(--raised); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / 22%); }
.set-line.dragging .grip { cursor: grabbing; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .set-line.making-room { transition: transform .12s ease-out; }
}
/* A song's setting: its key, mode and capo, under its line. */
.set-edit { grid-column: 2 / -1; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px 10px; margin: 4px 0 6px; }
.set-edit .f { flex: 0 1 8rem; }
.set-edit select, .book-more .f input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--control-edge); background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: .95rem;
  font-weight: 400; }
.set-edit select:disabled { opacity: .55; }
.set-edit .actions { flex: 1 1 100%; }

.sync-status[data-tone="done"] { color: var(--found); }
.sync-status a { font-weight: 650; }
.sync-ends { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px;
  padding-top: 4px; }
.sync-ends .btn { min-width: 96px; min-height: 44px; }
.sync-ends #sync-go { margin-inline-start: auto; }
/* A conflict: the song, "1 of 2", each side's version, and which to keep. */
.sync-card { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--card); }
.sync-card-name { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-card-at { margin: -6px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .84rem; }
.sync-two { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.sync-side { min-width: 0; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--surface); }
.sync-side-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: .9rem; }
.sync-side-head [data-icon] { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.sync-lines { display: grid; gap: 6px; margin: 0; font-size: .88rem; }
.sync-lines dt { color: var(--muted); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 600; }
.sync-lines dd { margin: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-lines[data-state="reading"] { color: var(--muted); }
.sync-ask { margin: 4px 0 0; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; }
.sync-pair { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.sync-pair .btn { gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
.sync-pair [data-icon] { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.sync-same { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px;
  color: var(--muted); font-size: .88rem; cursor: pointer; }
.sync-same input { width: 18px; height: 18px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--accent); }
/* On its way. */
.sync-going-line { margin: 0; font-weight: 650; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-going-line:focus { outline: none; }
.sync-going-line[data-tone="failed"] { color: var(--failed); }
.sync-going-line:is([data-tone="running"], [data-tone="queued"]) { color: var(--auto); }
.sync-going-detail { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .86rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-going-detail:empty { display: none; }
/* What it did: the two sides, this device on the left, and a lane a kind of change between them. */
.sync-devs { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 0 2px; }
.sync-dev { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; width: 120px; color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .8rem; text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-dev [data-icon] { width: 40px; height: 40px; color: var(--text); }
.sync-sections { display: grid; }
.sync-section { --lane: var(--muted); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--lane); }
.sync-section[data-kind="taken"] { --lane: var(--sync-take); }
.sync-section[data-kind="given"] { --lane: var(--sync-give); }
.sync-section[data-kind="conflicts"] { --lane: var(--sync-both); }
.sync-section[data-kind="songbooks"] { --lane: var(--sync-book); }
.sync-section[data-kind="indexes"] { --lane: var(--sync-index); }
.sync-lane { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 22px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%;
  min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 0; border: 0; background: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer; }
.sync-lane-words { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; }
.sync-lane-said { font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 500; text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-arrow { display: block; width: 100%; height: 14px; }
.sync-arrow svg { stroke-width: 2.5; stroke-linecap: butt; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; }
.sync-arrow .head { display: none; }
.sync-arrow[data-way~="left"] .head.left, .sync-arrow[data-way~="right"] .head.right { display: inline; }
.sync-section[data-kind="conflicts"] .sync-arrow .shaft { stroke-dasharray: 6 4; }
.sync-chev { width: 20px; height: 20px; color: var(--muted); transition: transform .15s; }
.sync-lane[aria-expanded="true"] .sync-chev { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.sync-rows { display: grid; gap: 4px; margin: 0; padding: 0 0 10px 6px; list-style: none; font-size: .88rem; }
.sync-rows li { padding: 3px 0 3px 10px; border-left: 2px solid currentColor; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sync-row-name { color: var(--text); }
.sync-row-said { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: .82rem; }
.sync-up { color: var(--found); }
.sync-down { color: var(--failed); }
.sync-note { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .86rem; }
/* Five tabs on a phone's width (Library, Songbooks, Sites, Requests, Sync: caracole serve's page): a little closer
   than four, and never wider than the page: past its width, the row of tabs scrolls by itself, the page never does.
   Below 380px (a small phone) they take a row of their own under the mark, whose summary goes beside it. */
@media (max-width: 719px) {
  .masthead.lib .tabs:has(#tab-sync) { overflow: auto hidden; overscroll-behavior-x: contain; scrollbar-width: none;
    padding-bottom: 1px; }  /* room for the chosen tab's line, which hangs 1px below the row */
  .masthead.lib .tabs:has(#tab-sync)::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .masthead.lib .tabs:has(#tab-sync) .tab { padding: 0 3px; font-size: .84rem; }
}
@media (max-width: 379px) {
  .masthead.lib:has(#tab-sync) { grid-template-areas: "app sum" "tabs tabs"; }
  .masthead.lib:has(#tab-sync):has(.scratch) { grid-template-areas: "app name" "tabs tabs" "sum sum"; }
  .masthead.lib:has(#tab-sync) .tabs { justify-content: space-between; }
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .sync-ends .btn, .sync-pair .btn, .sync-row .btn, .sync-panel-go .btn { min-height: 44px; }
}
/* The Requests tab (requests.js): under Now the request that runs, a card with its steps (steps.css), and those
   queued, each with Cancel; then what ended, under Today and Earlier, each with its outcome as a coloured word, its
   reason, its next step, when it ended and its Output, folded. On a phone a request's parts stack: its line, the
   reason, the steps; its next step with Output beside it. From 640 px its next step sits beside its line. */
.reqs { padding-top: 10px; }
.reqs-status { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--failed); font-weight: 600; }
.reqs-status:empty { display: none; }
.reqs-empty { margin: 24px 0; color: var(--muted); }
.req-head { margin: 22px 0 8px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em;
  text-transform: uppercase; }
.req-group:first-child .req-head { margin-top: 6px; }
.req-list { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.req { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 6px 12px;
  padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow); scroll-margin-top: 16px; }
.req:focus { outline: none; }
.req:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.req-line { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 10px; min-height: 32px; margin: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.req-song { font-weight: 650; }
.req-ago { color: var(--muted); font-size: .88rem; }
.req-says { padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--ignored); background: var(--ignored-bg); }
.req-says:is([data-tone="ready"], [data-tone="removed"], [data-tone="done"]) { color: var(--found);
  background: var(--found-bg); }
.req-says:is([data-tone="running"], [data-tone="added"]) { color: var(--auto); background: var(--auto-bg); }
.req-says:is([data-tone="waiting"], [data-tone="missing"]) { color: var(--wanted); background: var(--wanted-bg); }
.req-says[data-tone="review"] { color: var(--review); background: var(--review-bg); }
.req-says[data-tone="failed"] { color: var(--failed); background: var(--failed-bg); }
.req-reason { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .9rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.req-next { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 12px; }
.req-next form { margin: 0; }
.req .btn.act { min-height: 44px; }
.req-when { color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.req-error { flex-basis: 100%; margin: 0; color: var(--failed); font-size: .85rem; }
.req.running { padding: 14px 16px; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--auto) 45%, var(--border)); }
.req.running .req-song { font-size: 1.15rem; }
/* The running card's steps, across the card, each as wide as the row leaves it. */
.req .step-chips { gap: 6px; margin: 2px 0 0; }
.req .step-chip { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 4.5rem; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: .8rem;
  text-align: center; }
.req-line, .req-reason, .req .step-chips, .req-output[open], .req.running .req-output { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.req-next { grid-column: 1; }
.req.over .req-output:not([open]), .req.queued .req-output:not([open]) { grid-column: 2; }
@media (min-width: 640px) {
  /* The song's line and the reason; beside them the next step, when it ended, and Output, which unfolds under the
     whole request. */
  .req { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; }
  .req-line .req-says { margin-left: auto; }  /* the outcome at the end of the song's line */
  .req.over .req-line, .req.queued .req-line { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
  .req.over .req-reason { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; }
  .req-next { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / span 2; justify-content: flex-end; }
  .req.over .req-output:not([open]), .req.queued .req-output:not([open]) { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1 / span 2; }
  .req-output[open] { grid-row: 3; }
}
.req-output > summary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; }
.req-output > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.req-output > summary::before { content: "›"; display: inline-block; width: 1em; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1;
  text-align: center; }
.req-output[open] > summary::before { transform: rotate(90deg); }
.req-meta { margin: 2px 0 8px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.req-steps { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.req-steps.stages { margin-bottom: 8px; }  /* a lookup's stages, above the one command that ran them */
.req-step { padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--raised); }
.req-step .req-meta { margin: 4px 0 0; }
.req-step-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; font-size: .92rem;
  font-weight: 600; }
.req-note { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--review); font-size: .85rem; }
.req .badge:is(.waiting, .skipped, .cancelled) { color: var(--ignored); background: var(--ignored-bg); }
.req .badge.interrupted { color: var(--wanted); background: var(--wanted-bg); }  /* the server stopped it */
.req-output pre { max-height: 22rem; margin: 6px 0 0; padding: 10px; overflow: auto; border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--bg); font: .8rem/1.45 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
</style>
</head>

    const artist = String(r.artist || "");
    const row = el("article", "row");
    row.tabIndex = -1;
    if (r.status) row.dataset.status = String(r.status);
    const heading = el("h2", "row-title", title);
    heading.title = title;
    row.appendChild(r.href ? titleLink(r.href, heading) : heading);
    // The artist and the key, the status and the badges: one wrapping line under the title on a phone,
    // where badges that don't fit go under the artist, never over it; their own columns on a desktop.
    const sub = el("div", "row-sub");
    if (artist) sub.appendChild(artistOf(artist, r.onSearch, r.onArtist, "row-artist"));
    const meta = el("p", "row-meta");
    if (typeof r.key === "string" && r.key) meta.appendChild(keyMark("row-key", r));
    for (const badge of listOf(r.badges)) {
      if (badge && badge.text) meta.appendChild(el("span", "badge " + String(badge.kind || ""), badge.text));
    }
    if (r.facts) meta.appendChild(el("span", "row-facts", r.facts));
    if (meta.childNodes.length) sub.appendChild(meta);
    if (sub.childNodes.length) row.appendChild(sub);
    const mark = sourceMark(r.source);
    if (mark) row.appendChild(mark);
    const action = el("div", "row-action");
    const main = mainAction(r);
    if (main) action.appendChild(main);
    row.appendChild(action);
    foldMore(row, title, r.more, "row");
    return row;
  };

  // --- the offline indexes' hits, as /api/search and /api/artist give them --------------------------
  // caracole serve's lookup page draws each as a row with its site's mark; index.html's search, a song as a line
  // (indexLine, below), its sites' rows on it. ``get(pick, display, row, button)`` is what a Get it does: ``pick``
  // is the form POST /lookup takes (a song of yours by its id, else its artist and title; the UG song, the tab).
  const many = (n, word) => Number(n || 0).toLocaleString("en") + " " + word + (Number(n) === 1 ? "" : "s");
  const button = (label, cls, onclick, aria) => {
    const b = el("button", "btn " + (cls || "small"), label);
    b.type = "button";
    if (aria) b.setAttribute("aria-label", aria);
    b.addEventListener("click", onclick);
    return b;
  };
  // A line's button that looks a song up now (a song of yours' Fetch now, a site's song's Get it, Add again): the
  // download glyph alone, in the accent, named ``aria`` for a screen reader and the pointer's tooltip; ``onclick``
  // what it does, or none for a form's submit button (library.js fetchForm). Nothing is sent before it is pressed.
  const fetchIcon = (aria, onclick) => {
    const b = el("button", "btn small primary line-fetch");
    b.type = onclick ? "button" : "submit";
    b.setAttribute("aria-label", aria);
    b.title = aria;
    b.appendChild(glyph("download"));
    if (onclick) b.addEventListener("click", onclick);
    return b;
  };
  // A hit's song name that does what its Get it does (``main``, the button of the row or line ``item``): a button in
  // its heading that looks like the name, underlined under the pointer and at the keyboard's focus, named for what
  // it does (``said``: "Get Oasis - Wonderwall"). Pressed, it presses ``main``, so the same call takes the same pick,
  // display, row and button; it is disabled whenever ``main`` is (its request on its way) or has left the item (its
  // request line in its place), so one song is never two lookups. None where ``main`` is no button or is disabled,
  // or the title opens something already (titleLink): a link is never traded for a fetch.
  const nameDoes = (item, main, said) => {
    if (!(main instanceof HTMLButtonElement) || main.disabled) return;
    const heading = item.querySelector("h2, h3");
    if (!heading || heading.closest("a")) return;
    const name = el("button", "title-get", heading.textContent);
    name.type = "button";
    name.setAttribute("aria-label", said);
    name.title = main.title ? said + ": " + main.title.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + main.title.slice(1) : said;
    name.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (!main.disabled && item.contains(main)) main.click();
    });
    heading.classList.add("gets");
    heading.replaceChildren(name);
    const mirror = () => {
      const off = main.disabled || !item.contains(main);
      if (name.disabled !== off) name.disabled = off;  // set alike, it would be a change heard again
    };
    new MutationObserver(mirror).observe(item, { subtree: true, childList: true, attributes: true,
      attributeFilter: ["disabled"] });
  };
  const KINDS = { chords: "Chords", tabs: "Tab", ukulele: "Ukulele chords" };
  const COUNTED = { chords: "chords", tabs: "tabs", ukulele: "ukulele chords" };
  // What a row is for, when it is one instrument's (``instruments``: "ukulele", UG's Ukulele Chords; "harmonica",
  // a harmonica tab of harptabs.com; "score", MuseScore's pages and the scores you filed): a badge each, as a source
  // has its mark. Nothing is left out for it: a chord sheet is every instrument's, and says nothing.
  const INSTRUMENTS = { ukulele: "Ukulele", harmonica: "Harmonica", score: "Score", guitar: "Guitar", bass: "Bass",
    mandolin: "Mandolin", banjo: "Banjo" };  // the last four, gametabs.net's tabs' (``instruments``, as its pages name them)
  const instrumentBadges = (instruments) => listOf(instruments)
    .filter((x, n, all) => own.call(INSTRUMENTS, x) && all.indexOf(x) === n)
    .map((x) => ({ kind: "instrument " + x, text: INSTRUMENTS[x] }));
  // The sites whose index names a title alone, and the instrument their pages are for.
  const TITLE_SITES = { musescore: { name: "MuseScore", instrument: "score" },
    harptabs: { name: "harptabs.com", instrument: "harmonica" } };
  // An Ultimate Guitar song's instruments, by its tabs per type: ukulele, when UG has its Ukulele Chords.
  const ugInstruments = (c) => (c && typeof c === "object" && Number(c.ukulele) > 0 ? ["ukulele"] : []);
  const counts = (c) => Object.entries(c && typeof c === "object" ? c : {})
    .map(([kind, n]) => n + " " + (own.call(COUNTED, kind) ? COUNTED[kind] : kind)).join(" · ");
  // A song's sheet viewer or PDF, as its line opens it: a link of the library's, relative to the page.
  const opener = (files) => listOf(files).find((f) => f && f.primary && /[.](html|pdf)$/i.test(String(f.name || "")))
    || null;
  const yours = (hit) => (hit && hit.library && typeof hit.library === "object" ? hit.library : null);
  // A song of yours that caracole has found a sheet for (not one still wanted, ignored or never fetched): what a
  // search's results set apart (rows.css, a line or row of class ``have``).
  const held = (mine) => Boolean(mine) && mine.status === "found";
  // Under a hit's "⋯", given ``later(pick, display, row, button)``: the song into wanted.txt under the site's
  // names, for the nightly run to look up (index.html's results; /lookup gets songs now alone).
  const laterGroup = (later, pick, display, row) => {
    const box = el("div", "row-group later");
    box.appendChild(el("p", "subhead", "Later"));
    const go = button("Add for tonight's run", "small", (e) => later(pick, display, row(), e.currentTarget),
      "Add " + display + " for tonight's run");
    go.title = "Into wanted.txt, as caracole add writes it: the nightly run looks it up";
    box.appendChild(go);
    return box;
  };
  // An Ultimate Guitar song's versions (``tabs``), under a "⋯": each a button, numbered within its kind ("Chords 2 of
  // 13", of ``totals``), with a link to look at it on UG; ``choose(tab, button)`` is what its button does.
  const versionsOf = (tabs, totals, display, choose) => {
    const versions = el("ul", "versions");
    const nth = {};
    const of = totals && typeof totals === "object" ? totals : {};
    for (const t of tabs) {
      nth[t.type] = (nth[t.type] || 0) + 1;
      const kind = own.call(KINDS, t.type) ? KINDS[t.type] : String(t.type);
      const name = kind + " " + nth[t.type] + " of " + (of[t.type] || nth[t.type]) + (t.label ? " · " + t.label : "");
      const item = el("li", "version");
      item.appendChild(button(name, "small", (e) => choose(t, e.currentTarget), "Get " + name + ", " + display));
      const ug = el("a", "on-ug", "on UG");
      ug.href = /^https:[/][/]/i.test(String(t.url || "")) ? String(t.url) : "#";
      ug.target = "_blank";
      ug.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
      ug.setAttribute("aria-label", name + ", " + display + ", on Ultimate Guitar");
      item.appendChild(ug);
      versions.appendChild(item);
    }
    const box = el("div", "row-group");
    box.appendChild(el("p", "subhead", "Versions"));
    box.appendChild(versions);
    return box;
  };
  // A song's harmonica tabs on harptabs.com (``tabs``: each one's title, page and chips, the most viewed first), under a
  // "⋯": each a button, ``choose(tab, button)`` what it does, with a link to look at it there.
  const harpTabsOf = (tabs, display, choose) => {
    const list = el("ul", "versions");
    for (const t of tabs) {
      const said = [t.key ? "key " + String(t.key) : "", Number(t.views) ? Number(t.views).toLocaleString("en") + " views"
        : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
      const name = String(t.title || "") + (said ? " · " + said : "");
      const item = el("li", "version");
      item.appendChild(button(name, "small", (e) => choose(t, e.currentTarget), "Get " + display + " with the tab " +
        String(t.title || "")));
      const there = el("a", "on-ug", "on harptabs.com");
      there.href = https(t.url) ? String(t.url) : "#";
      there.target = "_blank";
      there.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
      there.setAttribute("aria-label", String(t.title || "") + ", " + display + ", on harptabs.com");
      item.appendChild(there);
      list.appendChild(item);
    }
    const box = el("div", "row-group");
    box.appendChild(el("p", "subhead", "Harmonica tabs on harptabs.com"));
    box.appendChild(list);
    return box;
  };
  // A track's tabs on gametabs.net (``tabs``: each one's title, page, views, instruments and composers, the most viewed
  // first), under a "⋯": each a button, ``choose(tab, button)`` what it does, with a link to look at it there.
  const gameTabsOf = (tabs, display, choose) => {
    const list = el("ul", "versions");
    tabs.forEach((t, n) => {
      const said = [...listOf(t.instruments), ...listOf(t.composers).map((c) => "by " + c),
        Number(t.views) ? Number(t.views).toLocaleString("en") + " views" : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
      const name = "Tab " + (n + 1) + (said ? " · " + said : "");
      const item = el("li", "version");
      item.appendChild(button(name, "small", (e) => choose(t, e.currentTarget), "Get " + display + " with " + name));
      const there = el("a", "on-ug", "on gametabs.net");
      there.href = https(t.url) ? String(t.url) : "#";
      there.target = "_blank";
      there.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
      there.setAttribute("aria-label", name + ", " + display + ", on gametabs.net");
      item.appendChild(there);
      list.appendChild(item);
    });
    const box = el("div", "row-group");
    box.appendChild(el("p", "subhead", "Tabs on gametabs.net"));
    box.appendChild(list);
    return box;
  };
  // A track's instruments as badges: gametabs.net names them ("Guitar", "Bass").
  const gameInstruments = (hit) => listOf(hit && hit.instruments).map((x) => String(x).toLowerCase());
  // An Ultimate Guitar song: Get it (Get it again for a song of yours, looked up as that song), which its name does
  // too (nameDoes), and its versions under "⋯" (versionsOf).
  const ugHit = (h, get, later) => {
    const hit = h && typeof h === "object" ? h : {};
    const mine = yours(hit);
    const artist = String(hit.artist || "");
    const title = String(hit.title || "");
    const display = mine ? String(mine.display || "") : artist + " - " + title;
    const pick = (extra) => Object.assign(mine ? { song: mine.id } : { artist, title }, { ug: hit.ug }, extra);
    let row = null;
    const main = button(mine ? "Get it again" : "Get it", "small primary", (e) => get(pick({}), display, row, e.currentTarget),
      (mine ? "Get " + display + " again" : "Get " + display) + " from Ultimate Guitar");
    const more = [];
    const tabs = listOf(hit.tabs).filter((t) => t && typeof t === "object");
    if (tabs.length) more.push(versionsOf(tabs, hit.counts, display, (t, go) => get(pick({ tab: t.url }), display, row, go)));
    const opens = mine ? opener(mine.links) : null;
    if (opens) more.push({ heading: "In your library", links: [{ label: opens.label, href: opens.href, source: opens.source }] });
    // Not under one of UG's misc-… names ("Misc Mashups"): no one's, the song would never be found by it.
    if (later && !mine && !hit.no_ones) more.push(laterGroup(later, { artist, title }, display, () => row));
    row = resultRow({ title, artist, onSearch: searchesFor(artist), source: "ug", facts: counts(hit.counts),
      badges: [...(mine ? [{ kind: "found", text: "In your library" }] : []), ...instrumentBadges(ugInstruments(hit.counts))],
      action: main, more });
    row.classList.add("hit");
    if (held(mine)) row.classList.add("have");
    row.dataset.ug = String(hit.ug || "");
    row.dataset.source = "ug";
    nameDoes(row, main, mine ? "Get " + display + " again" : "Get " + display);
    const dots = row.querySelector(".row-more");
    if (dots && tabs.length) {  // what "⋯" holds, said: its versions
      dots.title = "Versions of " + display;
      dots.setAttribute("aria-label", "Versions of " + display);
    }
    return row;
  };
  // An artist of the offline index, with their most tabbed songs said: ``open(a)`` lists every one.
  const artistHit = (a, open) => {
    const top = listOf(a && a.top).map((t) => t && t.title).filter(Boolean);
    const go = button("Songs", "small primary", () => open(a), "Songs by " + String(a.artist) + " on Ultimate Guitar");
    const row = resultRow({ title: a.artist, artist: top.length ? "Artist · " + top.join(", ") : "Artist", source: "ug",
      facts: many(a.songs, "song"), action: go });
    row.classList.add("hit", "artist-hit");
    row.dataset.artist = String(a.artist_key || "");
    row.dataset.source = "ug";
    return row;
  };
  // A page of gtptabs.com's index (a song with a Guitar Pro file there): Get it looks the song up as
  // caracole get does, whose gtptabs.com stage downloads one file for a song that has none; or MuseScore's,
  // a title alone, which caracole never fetches: a link to open; or a song of LaCuerda's index, whose Get it
  // looks the song up and keeps that LaCuerda sheet (``lacuerda``: the song's page, for one with chords
  // there), as Add for tonight's run records it for the nightly run. A song's name does what its Get it does
  // (nameDoes).
  const siteHit = (h, get, later) => {
    const hit = h && typeof h === "object" ? h : {};
    const title = String(hit.title || "");
    let row = null;
    if (hit.source === "lacuerda") {
      const mine = yours(hit);
      const artist = String(hit.artist || "");
      const display = mine ? String(mine.display || "") : artist + " - " + title;
      const chords = /^https:[/][/]/i.test(String(hit.sheet || "")) && /^https:[/][/]/i.test(String(hit.url || ""));
      const picked = chords ? { lacuerda: String(hit.url) } : {};
      const pick = Object.assign(mine ? { song: mine.id } : { artist, title }, picked);
      const main = button(mine ? "Get it again" : "Get it", "small primary", (e) => get(pick, display, row, e.currentTarget),
        (mine ? "Get " + display + " again" : "Get " + display) + (chords ? " from LaCuerda" : ""));
      main.title = chords ? "Looks the song up now, and keeps this LaCuerda sheet"
        : "Looks the song up now: LaCuerda has no chords for it";
      const more = [{ heading: "On LaCuerda", links: [{ label: "Its page", href: hit.url, source: "lacuerda" }] }];
      const opens = mine ? opener(mine.links) : null;
      if (opens) more.push({ heading: "In your library", links: [{ label: opens.label, href: opens.href, source: opens.source }] });
      if (later && !mine) more.push(laterGroup(later, Object.assign({ artist, title }, picked), display, () => row));
      row = resultRow({ title, artist, onSearch: searchesFor(artist), source: "lacuerda",
        facts: many(Number(hit.versions) || 1, "version") + (chords ? "" : " · no chords"),
        badges: mine ? [{ kind: "found", text: "In your library" }] : [], action: main, more });
      nameDoes(row, main, mine ? "Get " + display + " again" : "Get " + display);
    } else if (hit.source === "harptabs" && hit.artist) {  // harptabs.com's song, by an artist whose page was read
      const mine = yours(hit);
      const artist = String(hit.artist || "");
      const display = mine ? String(mine.display || "") : artist + " - " + title;
      const tabs = listOf(hit.tabs).filter((t) => t && typeof t === "object" && https(t.url));
      const pick = (url) => Object.assign(mine ? { song: mine.id } : { artist, title }, { harptabs: String(url) });
      const main = button(mine ? "Get it again" : "Get it", "small primary", (e) => get(pick(hit.url), display, row,
        e.currentTarget), (mine ? "Get " + display + " again" : "Get " + display) + " with its harmonica tab");
      main.title = "Looks the song up now, and keeps this harptabs.com tab";
      const more = [];
      if (tabs.length) more.push(harpTabsOf(tabs, display, (t, go) => get(pick(t.url), display, row, go)));
      const opens = mine ? opener(mine.links) : null;
      if (opens) more.push({ heading: "In your library", links: [{ label: opens.label, href: opens.href, source: opens.source }] });
      row = resultRow({ title, artist, onSearch: searchesFor(artist), source: "harptabs",
        facts: many(Number(hit.uploads) || 1, "harmonica tab"),
        badges: [...(mine ? [{ kind: "found", text: "In your library" }] : []), ...instrumentBadges(["harmonica"])],
        action: main, more });
      nameDoes(row, main, mine ? "Get " + display + " again" : "Get " + display);
    } else if (hit.source === "gametabs") {  // gametabs.net's track of a game: the game is its artist
      const mine = yours(hit);
      const artist = String(hit.artist || "");
      const display = mine ? String(mine.display || "") : artist + " - " + title;
      const tabs = listOf(hit.tabs).filter((t) => t && typeof t === "object" && https(t.url));
      const pick = (url) => Object.assign(mine ? { song: mine.id } : { artist, title }, { gametabs: String(url) });
      const main = button(mine ? "Get it again" : "Get it", "small primary", (e) => get(pick(hit.url), display, row,
        e.currentTarget), (mine ? "Get " + display + " again" : "Get " + display) + " with its tab from gametabs.net");
      main.title = "Looks the song up now, and keeps this gametabs.net tab";
      const more = [];
      if (tabs.length) more.push(gameTabsOf(tabs, display, (t, go) => get(pick(t.url), display, row, go)));
      const opens = mine ? opener(mine.links) : null;
      if (opens) more.push({ heading: "In your library", links: [{ label: opens.label, href: opens.href, source: opens.source }] });
      const composers = listOf(hit.composers);
      row = resultRow({ title, artist, onSearch: searchesFor(artist), source: "gametabs",
        facts: many(Number(hit.uploads) || 1, "tab") + (composers.length ? " · by " + composers.join(", ") : ""),
        badges: [...(mine ? [{ kind: "found", text: "In your library" }] : []), ...instrumentBadges(gameInstruments(hit))],
        action: main, more });
      nameDoes(row, main, mine ? "Get " + display + " again" : "Get " + display);
    } else if (own.call(TITLE_SITES, String(hit.source))) {  // MuseScore's or harptabs.com's: a title alone
      const site = TITLE_SITES[hit.source];
      row = resultRow({ title, artist: "Same title: maybe another song", source: hit.source,
        badges: instrumentBadges([site.instrument]), action: { label: "Open", href: hit.url } });
      const open = row.querySelector(".row-action a");
      if (open) open.setAttribute("aria-label", "Open " + title + " on " + site.name + ", in a new tab");
    } else {
      const mine = yours(hit);
      const artist = String(hit.artist || "");
      const display = mine ? String(mine.display || "") : artist + " - " + title;
      const pick = mine ? { song: mine.id } : { artist, title };
      const main = button(mine ? "Get it again" : "Get it", "small primary", (e) => get(pick, display, row, e.currentTarget),
        (mine ? "Get " + display + " again" : "Get " + display) + ", with a Guitar Pro file from gtptabs.com");
      main.title = "Looks the song up now, as caracole get does: its sheet, then a Guitar Pro file from gtptabs.com";
      const uploads = Number(hit.uploads) || 1;
      const more = [{ heading: "On gtptabs.com", links: [{ label: "Its page", href: hit.url, source: "gtptabs" }] }];
      if (later && !mine) more.push(laterGroup(later, { artist, title }, display, () => row));
      row = resultRow({ title, artist, onSearch: searchesFor(artist), source: "gtptabs",
        facts: uploads > 1 ? many(uploads, "upload") : "Guitar Pro",
        badges: mine ? [{ kind: "found", text: "In your library" }] : [], action: main, more });
      nameDoes(row, main, mine ? "Get " + display + " again" : "Get " + display);
    }
    row.classList.add("hit");
    if (held(yours(hit))) row.classList.add("have");
    row.dataset.source = String(hit.source || "");
    return row;
  };

  // --- index.html's search: a song of the sites a dense line, under its artist's header --------------------
  // "chords ×9 · tabs ×2": an Ultimate Guitar song's tabs per type, as a line counts them. The index holds no
  // ratings (only the sheets caracole fetched have them), so a line never shows stars.
  const TIMES = { chords: "chords", tabs: "tabs", ukulele: "ukulele chords" };
  const tabCounts = (c) => Object.entries(c && typeof c === "object" ? c : {})
    .map(([kind, n]) => (own.call(TIMES, kind) ? TIMES[kind] : kind) + " ×" + Number(n || 0)).join(" · ");
  const https = (url) => /^https:[/][/]/i.test(String(url || ""));
  // One song of the offline indexes (``item``): each site's row of it, as /api/search gives them (``ug``, an Ultimate
  // Guitar song; ``lacuerda`` and ``gtptabs``, a song of theirs; ``removed``, a song caracole removed), on one line
  // with each site's mark and its counts, and its identity (``key``) as the line's ``data-hit``. Get it looks the
  // song up as Ultimate Guitar's song (whose lookup gets gtptabs.com's Guitar Pro file too), else keeping
  // LaCuerda's sheet, else by its names; a removed song's is Add again, which asks for it again as the request form
  // does. Its name does what that button does (nameDoes). Under "⋯": UG's versions, LaCuerda's sheet and page,
  // gtptabs.com's page, Add for tonight's run.
  // ``acts``: { get, later, again }, each called (pick, display, line, button), as ugHit's ``get`` is.
  const indexLine = (item, acts) => {
    const it = item && typeof item === "object" ? item : {};
    const rowOf = (x) => (x && typeof x === "object" ? x : null);
    const ug = rowOf(it.ug);
    const lc = rowOf(it.lacuerda);
    const gtp = rowOf(it.gtptabs);
    const ht = rowOf(it.harptabs);
    const gt = rowOf(it.gametabs);
    const mine = [ug, lc, gtp, ht, gt].map(yours).find(Boolean) || null;  // a song of yours the page has no line of yet
    const gone = mine ? null : rowOf(it.removed);
    const first = ug || lc || gtp || ht || gt || gone || {};
    const title = String(first.title || "");
    const artist = String(first.artist || "");
    const display = mine ? String(mine.display || "") : artist + " - " + title;
    const pick = (extra) => Object.assign(mine ? { song: mine.id } : { artist, title }, extra);
    const chords = Boolean(lc) && https(lc.sheet) && https(lc.url);
    const sheet = chords ? { lacuerda: String(lc.url) } : {};

  // those that aren't 0, for the line a screen reader hears as the answer comes.

    item.dataset.n = String(Number(n) || 0);
    const count = el("span", "count-n", number(n));
    count.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");  // the mark's name says it
