  };
  // The marks of an answer (``data``, /api/search's), each a list's item; ``yours``, how many of your songs it shows,
  // for the first (none where it is null); ``found``, what each site's count is where the page counts it itself (the
  // library page, its lines: those "+ N more" listed too), else foundOn's.
  const foundIn = (d, found, source) => (found && own.call(found, source) ? Number(found[source]) || 0
    : foundOn(d, source));
  const countMarks = (data, yours, found) => {

      const page = document.querySelector("svg.mark");  // the page's own "¿", in its bar

      items.push(item);
    }
    for (const s of sitesOf(d.looked)) {

      const said = countSaid(s, n);
      const item = el("li", "count-mark");
      Object.assign(item.dataset, { source, state });
      const mark = sourceMark(source) || el("span", "source letters", siteName(s).slice(0, 2).toUpperCase());
      item.appendChild(named(mark, said));

      if (s.detail) mark.setAttribute("aria-description", String(s.detail));

    fold.appendChild(el("p", null, "Ultimate Guitar's sitemaps name some artists only by a number, mostly those with " +
      "accents or non-Latin letters (Joaquín Sabina, Maná, 宋冬野), so caracole can't see their tabs. If “" + query +
      "” is such an artist, find their page on ultimate-guitar.com and paste its address into overrides.toml:"));
    const entry = el("pre");
    entry.appendChild(el("code", null, String(u.entry || "")));

    fold.appendChild(el("p", null, "The nightly run then looks there for the songs you add by them."));

  // The read of a name LaCuerda's listings don't reach yet (``lacuerda_unlisted``: { name, letter }), one request:
  // ``ask(button, box)``; ``named``, the button says the name (beside results, which may name others). The one
  // LaCuerda button on the screen: the page's ``ask`` sends LaCuerda's search first, while its gate lets one go
  // (lacuerdaSearcher's ``ask``), as the tooltip says when the answer's gate does (``search``, the query).
  const askLaCuerda = (unlisted, ask, box, named, search) => {

// A song of yours on index.html: on its line, a button for each thing to play from (``plays``, rows.js puts them right

const caracoleCard = (icons, rows) => {

      const fetch = acts.keepMore ? acts.keepMore(rest, Number(v.keepMore) || 0) : null;
      if (fetch) {

  };

  const lacuerdaDrawer = (s, drawer, acts) => {
    const met = listOf(s.lacuerdaVersions).filter((x) => x && typeof x === "object");
    const title = String(s.title);
    const pinned = Boolean(s.versions && s.versions.pinned) && Boolean(acts.useLaCuerda);
    const extra = [];
    if (pinned) {
      extra.push(el("p", "pin-note", "Your choice on Ultimate Guitar is in use: Back to caracole's pick first."));
      if (acts.clear) extra.push(acts.clear());
    }
    drawer.appendChild(drawerHead(drawer, "lacuerda", "LaCuerda · chord sheets", many(met.length, "version") +
      " caracole met", extra));
    const ol = el("ol", "vrows");
    met.forEach((x, n) => {
      const ver = "Version " + (n + 1);
      const actions = [];
      if (x.sheet) actions.push(inUse());
      else if (acts.useLaCuerda && !pinned) actions.push(acts.useLaCuerda(x, ver));
      actions.push(openLink(x.href, ver + " of " + title + " on LaCuerda, in a new tab", { external: true }));
      ol.appendChild(versionRow({ ver, note: [lyricsShare(null, x.coverage) || "not scored"], actions,
        cls: x.sheet ? "cur" : "" }));
    });
    drawer.appendChild(ol);
  };
  // The auto sheet beside a human one (``autoSheet``): its viewer, and its files.
  const autoDrawer = (s, drawer) => {
    const a = s.autoSheet;
    const title = String(s.title);
    drawer.appendChild(drawerHead(drawer, "auto", "Auto sheet · from the recording", "made by caracole from the audio"));
    const ol = el("ol", "vrows");
    const downloads = listOf(a.files).filter((f) => f && f.href)
      .map((f) => downloadLink(f, String(f.label), "Download the auto sheet's " + String(f.label) + " of " + title));
    ol.appendChild(versionRow({ ver: "Auto sheet", note: downloads.length ? downloads : [],
      actions: [openLink(a.href, "Open the auto sheet of " + title)] }));
    drawer.appendChild(ol);
  };
  // One source's files of a tile (``group``): a row each, its label, Open where the page shows it, and Download.
  const filesDrawer = (s, drawer, t, group) => {
    const title = String(s.title);
    drawer.appendChild(drawerHead(drawer, group.source, nameOf(group.source) + " · " + t.plural,
      many(group.files.length, t.unit)));
    const ol = el("ol", "vrows");
    for (const f of group.files) {
      const label = plainLabel(f);
      const actions = [];
      const opens = t.opener ? t.opener(f) : null;
      if (opens) actions.push(openLink(opens.href, "Open " + label + " of " + title, opens));
      actions.push(downloadLink(f, "Download", "Download " + label + " of " + title));
      ol.appendChild(versionRow({ ver: label, note: [String(f.name)], actions }));
    }
    drawer.appendChild(ol);
  };

  // --- the tiles ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // A tile: its body opens what it holds (``open``, ``said`` its name for a screen reader), its subtitle says which
  // (``from``); its row of chips, one a source (``chips``: { source, count, unit, fixed, fill(drawer) }, after its
  // ``lead``); its formats as downloads (``downloads``). More than one version: a small stack. Every tile alike, none
  // first; an auto sheet's in its own colour.
  const tileOf = (t, card) => {
    const box = el("div", "tile tile-" + t.kind + (t.auto ? " auto" : ""));
    const chips = listOf(t.chips);
    if (chips.reduce((n, c) => n + (Number(c.count) || 0), 0) > 1) box.classList.add("stack");
    const open = anchor(t.open.href, "tile-open", t.open);
    open.setAttribute("aria-label", t.said);
    const ico = el("span", "tile-ico");
    ico.appendChild(glyph(t.glyph));
    const words = el("span", "tile-words");
    words.appendChild(el("span", "tile-name", t.name));
    if (t.from) {
      const from = words.appendChild(el("span", "tile-from", t.from));
      from.id = idFor("from");
      open.setAttribute("aria-describedby", from.id);
    }
    const go = el("span", "tile-go");
    go.appendChild(glyph(t.open.download !== undefined ? "download" : "open"));
    open.append(ico, words, go);
    box.appendChild(open);
    if (chips.length) {
      const row = el("div", "tile-versions");
      if (chips.length === 1 && chips[0].fixed) {
        const c = chips[0];
        row.appendChild(el("span", "lead", "From"));
        // A source that links back to its page (``href``: Megalobiz's or AZLyrics' lyrics) is that link.
        const one = c.href ? anchor(c.href, "vchip one", { external: true }) : el("span", "vchip one");
        if (c.href) one.setAttribute("aria-label", t.name + ": " + nameOf(c.source) + ", its page there");
        const mark = sourceMark(c.source);
        if (mark) one.appendChild(mark);
        one.appendChild(el("span", "vchip-name", nameOf(c.source)));
        row.appendChild(one);
      } else {
        row.appendChild(el("span", "lead", t.lead));
        for (const c of chips) row.appendChild(card.chip(box, c));
      }
      box.appendChild(row);
    }
    const downloads = listOf(t.downloads);
    if (downloads.length) {
      const strip = el("div", "tile-downloads");
      for (const d of downloads) strip.appendChild(d);
      box.appendChild(strip);
    }
    return box;
  };

  // What a song of yours holds to play from, in this order: its chord sheet (the human one, else the auto one; UG's
  // Ukulele Chords), its Guitar Pro files, its text tab, its harmonica tabs, its tabs of game music, its lyrics and the
  // scores you filed; a tile each in its card (tiles), and but its lyrics a button each on its line (plays). Each
  // { kind, glyph, name, open, said, from, lead, chips, downloads, opener, auto, sources, count, unit }: ``sources``,
  // where its versions came from, the one in use first; ``count``, how many versions of it the card lists (in its
  // drawers, or as files), in ``unit``s. ``opts``: ``guitar``, caracole serve shows Guitar Pro files (alphaTab);
  // ``acts``, what a drawer's versions do (Use this one, Fetch them, Back to caracole's pick, LaCuerda's Use this one:
  // each makes its control; or, from the file, ``keepMoreCommand``, the command that fetches them). ``claimed``,
  // given, gets every file a tile shows.
  const things = (s, opts) => {
    const o = opts || {};
    const acts = o.acts || {};
    const title = String(s.title);
    const files = listOf(s.files).filter((f) => f && typeof f.name === "string" && f.href);
    const named = (n) => files.find((f) => f.name === n) || null;
    const claim = (f) => {
      if (f && o.claimed) o.claimed.add(f);
      return f;
    };
    const made = [];

    // The chord sheet: the human one, else the auto one; its versions from each source.
    const primary = files.find((f) => f.primary) || null;
    const autoOnly = s.auto === true;
    if (primary && (HUMAN.test(primary.name) || AUTO.test(primary.name))) {
      const auto = s.autoSheet && typeof s.autoSheet === "object" && !autoOnly ? s.autoSheet : null;
      files.filter((f) => (autoOnly ? AUTO : HUMAN).test(f.name) || (auto && AUTO.test(f.name))).forEach(claim);
      const ukulele = listOf(s.instruments).indexOf("ukulele") >= 0;
      const name = autoOnly ? "Auto sheet" : ukulele ? "Ukulele chords" : "Chord sheet";
      const v = s.versions && typeof s.versions === "object" ? s.versions : null;
      const one = v ? listOf(v.list).find((x) => x && x.chosen) : null;
      const from = one ? ["Ver " + (Number(one.number) || "?"), stars(one), "in use"].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")
        : autoOnly || s.source === "auto" || s.source === "youtube" ? "from the recording"
        : s.source ? nameOf(s.source) : "";
      const chips = [];
      if (v && (Number(v.total) > 0 || listOf(v.list).length)) {
        chips.push({ source: "ug", count: Number(v.total) || listOf(v.list).length, unit: "version",
          fixed: Number(v.total) <= 1 && !(Number(v.rest) > 0), fill: (d) => ugDrawer(s, d, acts) });
      }
      const met = listOf(s.lacuerdaVersions);
      if (met.length) {
        chips.push({ source: "lacuerda", count: met.length, unit: "version",
          fixed: met.length === 1 && Boolean(met[0] && met[0].sheet), fill: (d) => lacuerdaDrawer(s, d, acts) });
      }
      if (auto) {
        chips.push({ source: "auto", count: 1, unit: "version", fixed: false, fill: (d) => autoDrawer(s, d) });
      }
      if (!chips.length && s.source) chips.push({ source: String(s.source), count: 1, fixed: true });
      const downloads = (autoOnly ? AUTO_FILES : SHEET_FILES).map(([n, label]) => [named(n), label])
        .filter(([f]) => f).map(([f, label]) => downloadLink(f, label, "Download the " + label + " of " + title));
      for (const f of files.filter((x) => typeof x.version === "string" && x.version)) {
        claim(f);
        downloads.push(downloadLink(f, "PDF · " + f.version, "Download the PDF of " + title + " in " + f.version));
      }
      // Its versions the card lists: UG's kept, LaCuerda's met, the auto sheet beside it; and the one in use, if none
      // of those is it (a sheet from your inbox, say). Where they came from, the one in use first.
      const kept = v ? listOf(v.list).filter((x) => x && typeof x === "object").length : 0;
      const listed = kept + met.length + (auto ? 1 : 0);
      const inUse = (s.source === "ug" && kept > 0) || (s.source === "lacuerda" && met.some((x) => x && x.sheet));
      const sources = [s.source, kept ? "ug" : "", met.length ? "lacuerda" : "", auto ? "auto" : ""];
      made.push({ kind: "sheet", glyph: ukulele ? "ukulele" : "sheet", name, auto: autoOnly,
        open: { href: primary.href }, said: "Open the " + name.toLowerCase() + " of " + title, from,
        lead: "Versions", chips, downloads, sources: distinct(sources), count: listed + (inUse ? 0 : 1),
        unit: "version" });
    }

    // Guitar Pro files (or a Power Tab file); and a text tab, a thing of its own.
    const guitar = files.filter((f) => GUITAR.test(f.name));
    const tab = named("tab.txt");
    const browser = (f) => (o.guitar && typeof f.guitarPage === "string" && f.guitarPage ? { href: f.guitarPage }
      : null);
    if (guitar.length) {
      guitar.forEach(claim);
      const first = guitar[0];
      const shown = browser(first);
      const ext = "." + GUITAR.exec(first.name)[1].toLowerCase();
      const t = { kind: "guitar", glyph: "guitar", name: "Guitar Pro", plural: "Guitar Pro files", unit: "file",
        open: shown || { href: first.href, download: typeof first.download === "string" ? first.download : "" },
        said: (shown ? "Open the Guitar Pro tab of " : "Download the Guitar Pro file of ") + title,
        from: String(first.name), lead: "Files",
        downloads: [downloadLink(first, ext, "Download " + plainLabel(first) + " of " + title)],
        opener: (f) => browser(f), count: guitar.length };
      t.chips = bySource(guitar).map((g) => ({ source: g.source, count: g.files.length, unit: "file",
        fixed: g.files.length === 1, fill: (d) => filesDrawer(s, d, t, g) }));
      made.push(t);
    }
    if (tab) {
      claim(tab);
      made.push({ kind: "tab", glyph: "guitar", name: "Guitar tab", open: { href: tab.href },
        said: "Open the guitar tab of " + title, from: tab.source ? nameOf(tab.source) : "a text tab", lead: "From",
        chips: tab.source ? [{ source: tab.source, count: 1, fixed: true }] : [],
        downloads: [downloadLink(tab, "Text", "Download the guitar tab of " + title)], count: 1, unit: "tab" });
    }

    // Harmonica tabs.
    const harp = files.filter((f) => HARMONICA.test(f.name));
    if (harp.length) {
      harp.forEach(claim);
      const first = harp[0];
      const t = { kind: "harmonica", glyph: "harmonica", name: "Harmonica tab", plural: "harmonica tabs", unit: "tab",
        open: { href: harpPage(first) || first.href }, said: "Open the harmonica tab of " + title,
        from: plainLabel(first).replace(/^Harmonica tab/, "Tab"), lead: "Tabs",
        downloads: [downloadLink(first, "Text", "Download " + plainLabel(first) + " of " + title)],
        opener: (f) => ({ href: harpPage(f) || f.href }), count: harp.length };
      t.chips = bySource(harp).map((g) => ({ source: g.source, count: g.files.length, unit: "tab",
        fixed: g.files.length === 1, fill: (d) => filesDrawer(s, d, t, g) }));
      made.push(t);
    }

    // Text tabs of game music from gametabs.net, opened as text, as Ultimate Guitar's tab.txt is.
    const games = files.filter((f) => GAMETAB.test(f.name));
    if (games.length) {
      games.forEach(claim);
      const first = games[0];
      const t = { kind: "gametab", glyph: "guitar", name: "Game music tab", plural: "game music tabs", unit: "tab",
        open: { href: first.href }, said: "Open the game music tab of " + title,
        from: plainLabel(first).replace(/^Game music tab/, "Tab"), lead: "Tabs",
        downloads: [downloadLink(first, "Text", "Download " + plainLabel(first) + " of " + title)],
        opener: (f) => ({ href: f.href }), count: games.length };
      t.chips = bySource(games).map((g) => ({ source: g.source, count: g.files.length, unit: "tab",
        fixed: g.files.length === 1, fill: (d) => filesDrawer(s, d, t, g) }));
      made.push(t);
    }

    // Lyrics, plain and timed: LRCLIB's, or Megalobiz's or AZLyrics', whose chip links to their page there (``lyricsFrom``).
    const lyrics = LYRICS.map(named).filter(Boolean);
    if (lyrics.length) {
      lyrics.forEach(claim);
      const plain = named("lyrics.txt");
      const timed = named("lyrics.lrc");
      const downloads = [];
      if (plain) downloads.push(downloadLink(plain, "Text", "Download the lyrics of " + title));
      if (timed) downloads.push(downloadLink(timed, "Timed (.lrc)", "Download the timed lyrics of " + title));
      const source = lyrics[0].source;
      const from = s.lyricsFrom && s.lyricsFrom.source === source && typeof s.lyricsFrom.href === "string"
        ? s.lyricsFrom.href : null;
      made.push({ kind: "lyrics", glyph: "lyrics", name: "Lyrics", open: { href: lyrics[0].href },
        said: "Open the lyrics of " + title, from: timed ? "synced to the recording" : "plain", lead: "From",
        chips: source ? [{ source, count: 1, fixed: true, href: from }] : [], downloads });
    }

    // Scores you filed.
    const scores = files.filter((f) => SCORE.test(f.name));
    if (scores.length) {
      scores.forEach(claim);
      const first = scores[0];
      const format = (f) => SCORE_FORMATS[SCORE.exec(f.name)[1]] || f.name;
      const pdf = /[.]pdf$/i.test(first.name);
      const t = { kind: "score", glyph: "score", name: "Score", plural: "scores", unit: "file",
        open: pdf ? { href: first.href } : { href: first.href, download: typeof first.download === "string"
          ? first.download : "" },
        said: (pdf ? "Open the score of " : "Download the score of ") + title, from: plainLabel(first), lead: "Files",
        downloads: scores.map((f) => downloadLink(f, format(f), "Download " + plainLabel(f) + " of " + title)),
        opener: (f) => (/[.]pdf$/i.test(f.name) ? { href: f.href } : null), count: scores.length };
      t.chips = bySource(scores).map((g) => ({ source: g.source, count: g.files.length, unit: "file",
        fixed: g.files.length === 1, fill: (d) => filesDrawer(s, d, t, g) }));
      made.push(t);
    }

    for (const t of made) {  // where each came from, as its chips say, but where it said already (the sheet's)
      if (!t.sources) t.sources = distinct(listOf(t.chips).map((c) => c.source));
      if (!t.count) t.count = 1;
    }
    return made;
  };
  const distinct = (keys) => keys.filter((k, n) => typeof k === "string" && k && keys.indexOf(k) === n);

  // A tile each (``things``, the same ``opts``), and the drawer their chips open, one at a time; null for none.
  const tiles = (s, opts) => {
    const made = things(s, opts);
    if (!made.length) return null;
    const box = el("div", "tiles");
    const drawer = el("div", "drawer");  // a region, named by its head; no section, as a line's group has one
    drawer.setAttribute("role", "region");
    drawer.id = idFor("drawer");
    drawer.hidden = true;
    let opened = null;  // the chip whose drawer shows
    const close = (focusBack) => {
      const chip = opened;
      opened = null;
      drawer.hidden = true;
      drawer.replaceChildren();
      if (chip) {
        chip.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
        if (focusBack) chip.focus();
      }
    };
    const card = {
      chip: (tileBox, c) => {
        const chip = el("button", "vchip");
        chip.type = "button";
        const said = nameOf(c.source) + ": " + many(c.count, c.unit || "version");
        chip.title = said;
        chip.setAttribute("aria-label", said);
        chip.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
        chip.setAttribute("aria-controls", drawer.id);
        chip.dataset.source = c.source;
        const mark = sourceMark(c.source);
        if (mark) {
          mark.removeAttribute("title");
          chip.appendChild(mark);
        }
        chip.appendChild(el("span", "n", c.count));
        chip.appendChild(glyph("chevron"));
        chip.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const was = opened === chip;
          close(false);
          if (was) return;
          const shut = el("button", "drawer-close");
          shut.type = "button";
          shut.title = "Close";
          shut.setAttribute("aria-label", "Close " + said);
          shut.appendChild(glyph("close"));
          shut.addEventListener("click", () => close(true));
          c.fill(drawer);
          const head = drawer.querySelector(".drawer-head");
          if (head) head.appendChild(shut);
          opened = chip;
          chip.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
          drawer.hidden = false;
          place(drawer, tileBox);
        });
        return chip;
      },
    };
    drawer.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (e.key !== "Escape") return;
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      close(true);
    });
    for (const t of made) box.appendChild(tileOf(t, card));
    box.appendChild(drawer);
    if (watch) watch.observe(box);
    return box;
  };
  // The drawer under the row of tiles that holds its tile (on a phone, one tile a row, right under it), its pointer
  // over the tile: placed when it opens, and again whenever its tiles' width moves them. Their box is watched, not the
  // window: a folded card's tiles, or a line the search left out, measure nothing, and are placed once they show.
  const placed = new WeakMap();  // a box of tiles -> its width when its drawer was placed
  const place = (drawer, tileBox) => {
    const box = drawer.parentNode;
    if (!box || !tileBox.isConnected || !tileBox.getClientRects().length) return;
    drawer.hidden = true;  // out of the rows while they are measured
    const top = Math.round(tileBox.getBoundingClientRect().top);
    let last = tileBox;
    for (const t of box.querySelectorAll(":scope > .tile")) {
      if (Math.round(t.getBoundingClientRect().top) === top) last = t;
    }
    last.after(drawer);
    drawer.hidden = false;
    const at = tileBox.getBoundingClientRect();
    drawer.style.setProperty("--point", Math.round(at.left + at.width / 2 - box.getBoundingClientRect().left) + "px");
    drawer.dataset.tile = String(Array.from(box.querySelectorAll(":scope > .tile")).indexOf(tileBox));
    placed.set(box, Math.round(box.getBoundingClientRect().width));
  };
  const watch = typeof ResizeObserver === "function" ? new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
    for (const entry of entries) {
      const box = entry.target;
      const width = Math.round(box.getBoundingClientRect().width);
      if (!width || placed.get(box) === width) continue;  // hidden, or where it was placed
      const drawer = box.querySelector(":scope > .drawer");
      const tileBox = drawer && !drawer.hidden ? box.querySelectorAll(":scope > .tile")[Number(drawer.dataset.tile)] : null;
      if (tileBox) place(drawer, tileBox);
    }
  }) : null;

  // --- the line's buttons -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // A song's line has a button for each thing it holds to play from but its lyrics (``things``, the same ``opts``),
  // in their order, none first: a link that opens it at once (its viewer, its harmonica tab's page, the Guitar Pro
  // page, the file: what its tile opens). Each its instrument's glyph (an auto sheet's in its own colour), the marks
  // of the sites its versions came from at its foot (two at most, the one in use first), how many versions the card
  // lists of it at its corner when more than one; named for all of it ("Open the harmonica tab of Creep, from
  // harptabs.com, 2 tabs"), and ``data-inst`` the Filter panel's instruments it is one of (library.js INSTRUMENTS),
  // which filter.css lights while one is on. None: null.
  const PLAYS = ["sheet", "guitar", "tab", "harmonica", "gametab", "score"];
  const MARKS_SHOWN = 2;
  const listed = (names) => (names.length > 1 ? names.slice(0, -1).join(", ") + " and " + names[names.length - 1]
    : names.join(""));
  const instOf = (s, t) => (t.kind === "sheet"
    ? (listOf(s.instruments).indexOf("ukulele") >= 0 ? "sheet ukulele" : "sheet")
    : t.kind === "harmonica" || t.kind === "score" ? t.kind : "guitar");
  const plays = (s, opts) => {
    const shown = things(s, opts).filter((t) => PLAYS.indexOf(t.kind) >= 0);
    if (!shown.length) return null;
    const box = el("span", "line-plays");
    for (const t of shown) {
      const a = anchor(t.open.href, "play play-" + t.kind + (t.auto ? " auto" : ""), t.open);
      const from = t.sources.map(nameOf);
      const said = t.said + (from.length ? ", from " + listed(from) : "") +
        (t.count > 1 ? ", " + many(t.count, t.unit || "version") : "");
      a.setAttribute("aria-label", said);
      a.title = said;
      a.dataset.kind = t.kind;
      a.dataset.inst = instOf(s, t);
      a.appendChild(glyph(t.glyph));
      if (t.count > 1) {
        const n = el("span", "n", t.count);
        n.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        a.appendChild(n);
      }
      const marks = el("span", "marks");
      marks.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      for (const key of t.sources.slice(0, MARKS_SHOWN)) {
        const mark = sourceMark(key);
        if (!mark) continue;
        mark.removeAttribute("title");
        marks.appendChild(mark);
      }
      if (marks.childNodes.length) a.appendChild(marks);
      box.appendChild(a);
    }
    return box;
  };

  // Which sites have the song (``sites``, song_sites.py, rows.js siteMarks), under its tiles: each site's mark in its
  // colours where it has it, grey where it had nothing, fainter on a dashed edge where it wasn't asked yet. None: null.
  const sitesOf = (sites) => {
    const marks = siteMarks(sites);
    if (!marks.childNodes.length) return null;
    const box = el("div", "card-sites");
    box.append(el("p", "card-label", "On the sites"), marks);
    return box;
  };

  // The song's progressions (``items``: { text, said, go }): chips that find your songs that play each.
  // The song's progressions, a chip each: four of them, the rest one press away ("+2"); a long string of numerals is
  // cut short in its chip (rows.css, ``prog-text``), the whole of it in its tooltip and for a screen reader.
  const PROGS_SHOWN = 4;
  const progressions = (items) => {
    const found = listOf(items).filter((p) => p && p.text);
    if (!found.length) return null;
    const box = el("div", "progressions");
    const label = el("p", "card-label", "Progressions");
    label.title = "Find your songs that play one";
    box.appendChild(label);
    const row = el("div", "progs");
    const chips = found.map((p) => {
      const go = el("button", "prog");
      go.type = "button";
      go.append(glyph("search"), el("span", "prog-text", String(p.text)));
      go.title = String(p.said || p.text);
      go.setAttribute("aria-label", String(p.said || p.text));
      go.addEventListener("click", p.go);
      row.appendChild(go);
      return go;
    });
    const rest = chips.slice(PROGS_SHOWN);
    if (rest.length) {
      for (const c of rest) c.hidden = true;
      const more = el("button", "progs-more", "+" + rest.length);
      more.type = "button";
      more.setAttribute("aria-label", "Show " + many(rest.length, "more progression"));
      more.addEventListener("click", () => {

    hint.appendChild(el("code", null, "caracole review --song " + shellQuote(String(s.display))));
    hint.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" lists what caracole search finds for it, to pick one."));
    return hint;
  };

  // The picker: a song in review's candidates, numbered as `caracole review` numbers them. The file shows
  // them with the line that picks one; caracole serve, with a form whose answer `caracole review --song`
  // writes (web/app.py). makePicker(song) builds it from a song of the data that has `candidates`.
  const choiceRow = (c, pickable) => {
    const row = el(pickable ? "div" : "li", "choice");
    const pick = el(pickable ? "label" : "div", "choice-pick");

    const text = el("span", "choice-text");
    text.appendChild(el("span", "choice-name", c.n + ". " + String(c.artist) + " – " + String(c.title)));
    const why = [c.why, "score " + (Number(c.score) || 0), c.tabs].filter(Boolean).map(String).join(" · ");
    text.appendChild(el("span", "choice-why", why));
    pick.appendChild(text);
    row.appendChild(pick);

      const page = link({ label: "UG", href: c.href }, "choice-link", true);

  const noneRow = () => {
    const row = el("div", "choice none");

    const radio = el("input");

    radio.setAttribute("name", "pick");
    radio.setAttribute("value", "none");
    radio.setAttribute("required", "");

    text.appendChild(el("span", "choice-name", "None of these"));
    text.appendChild(el("span", "choice-why", "caracole drops them for good and goes on looking for the song"));

    row.appendChild(pick);

  };
  // What a line shows under its chevron of a song with no picker: why its match waits (a review with no candidates
  // to pick from), or, on the file, the line that lists a song not found's search hits; else nothing (null).
  const unpicked = (s) => {
    if (SHOWS.review(s)) {
      const note = el("p", "note", "caracole isn't sure about this match: see the ");
      const todo = el("a", null, "to-do page");

      note.appendChild(document.createTextNode(", or run caracole review."));

  };
  const makePicker = (s) => {
    const cands = listOf(s.candidates).filter((c) => c && c.ref);
    const box = el("details", "picker");
    const question = "Which Ultimate Guitar song is “" + String(s.title) + "” by " + String(s.artist) + "?";
    const job = server ? jobOfSong(s.id) : null;
    const pickable = Boolean(server) && !busy.has(Number(s.id)) && !(job && isActive(job));
    const many = plural(cands.length, "candidate");
    const summary = el("summary", pickable ? "btn picker-open" : "picker-open", pickable ? "Pick the match" : many);
    if (pickable) summary.appendChild(el("span", "picker-n", "· " + many));
    box.appendChild(summary);
    if (!pickable) {
      const list = el("ol", "choices");
      list.setAttribute("aria-label", question);
      for (const c of cands) list.appendChild(choiceRow(c, false));
      box.appendChild(list);
      if (server) {
        box.appendChild(el("p", "pick-hint", "A request for this song is running: pick one once it ends."));
      } else {
        const hint = el("p", "pick-hint", "Pick one with ");
        hint.appendChild(el("code", null, "caracole review --song " + shellQuote(String(s.display))));
        hint.appendChild(document.createTextNode(": its number, or "));
        hint.appendChild(el("code", null, "n"));
        hint.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" for none of these."));
        box.appendChild(hint);
      }
      return box;
    }
    const form = songForm("pick-form", "/review", s);
    form.appendChild(hidden("shown", cands.map((c) => String(c.ref)).join(" ")));
    const group = el("fieldset", "choices");
    group.appendChild(el("legend", null, question));
    for (const c of cands) group.appendChild(choiceRow(c, true));
    group.appendChild(noneRow());
    form.appendChild(group);
    const row = el("div", "pick-row");
    const now = el("label", "pick-check");
    const fetch = el("input");
    fetch.setAttribute("type", "checkbox");
    fetch.setAttribute("name", "fetch");
    fetch.setAttribute("value", "1");
    fetch.setAttribute("checked", "");
    now.appendChild(fetch);
    now.appendChild(document.createTextNode("Fetch it now"));
    row.appendChild(now);
    const go = el("button", "btn primary", "Pick");
    go.type = "submit";
    row.appendChild(go);
    form.appendChild(row);
    form.appendChild(el("p", "pick-hint", "Your answer goes into overrides.toml, as caracole review writes it. " +
      "Fetch it now then asks Ultimate Guitar for the song picked; None of these fetches nothing."));
    box.appendChild(form);
    postInPlace(form, go, s);
    // Opened, the picker takes the focus to its candidates: the arrow keys then move between them.
    box.addEventListener("toggle", () => {
      if (!box.open) return;
      const first = form.querySelector("input[name=pick]:checked") || form.querySelector("input[name=pick]");
      if (first) first.focus();
    });
    return box;
  };

  let setArtist = () => {};
  let searchFor = () => {};
  let setProg = () => {};
  // The line over the list while it shows a progression's songs alone: "Songs with I–V–vi–IV, the pop progression ·
  // Show all".
  const drawProg = () => {
    progLine.hidden = !state.prog;
    if (progLine.dataset.prog === state.prog) return;
    progLine.dataset.prog = state.prog;
    progLine.replaceChildren();
    if (!state.prog) return;
    progLine.append("Songs with " + progSaid(state.prog) + " · ", button("Show all", "small", () => {
      state.prog = "";
      render();
      save();
      input.focus();
    }, "Show every song, not only those with " + progNumerals(state.prog)));
  };
  // The song's progressions, as it plays them, for its card: each shows the songs that play it too.
  const progressionsOf = (s) => card.progressions(progsOf(s).map((p) => ({ text: String(p.plays || progLabel(p.key)),
    said: "Your songs with " + progSaid(p.key), go: () => setProg(p.key) })));

  // Lines: a song a line (resultRow's dense form, from ROWS_SCRIPT: the seam the module docstring describes), in
  // its artist's group. A line is an article titled by its h3; the A-Z strip moves the focus to its group.
  // A song's main action on its line when the server's control holds the line's button (``held``): a wanted
  // song's fetch (Fetch now's download icon), or the button that opens its picker; Removing… while caracole removes
  // it; no button at all (``action`` null) while its request, or its removal, waits or runs, as the line's request
  // line then says how it goes. Not held, none: what the song holds has a button each after its title (card.js
  // plays), on the file too.
  const serverAction = (s, picker) => {
    const held = (action) => ({ held: true, action });
    if (server && removing.has(Number(s.id))) {
      const job = jobOfSong(s.id);
      if (job && job.kind === "remove") return held(null);
      const going = el("a", "line-busy", "Removing…");
      going.href = "#tab=requests";
      going.title = "See the requests";
      return held(going);
    }
    if (server && s.status === "wanted") {
      const job = jobOfSong(s.id);
      if ((job && isActive(job)) || busy.has(Number(s.id))) return held(null);
      if (s.fetchable === false && picker && picker.querySelector("form")) {
        // caracole fetch would refuse it until the match is picked: this opens the picker, in the line's panel.
        const pick = el("button", "btn small line-pick", "Pick the match");
        pick.type = "button";
        pick.setAttribute("aria-label", "Pick the match for " + String(s.title) + " by " + String(s.artist));
        pick.title = "Which Ultimate Guitar song this is: caracole isn't sure";
        pick.addEventListener("click", () => showPicker(picker));
        return held(pick);
      }
      if (s.fetchable === false) return held(reviewFirst("btn small"));
      return held(fetchForm(s));
    }
    return { held: false, action: null };
  };
  // A line's one word for where its song stands, when it needs something or isn't plainly yours: Needs review, Wanted
  // or Ignored. A song found, nearly every one, says nothing: null; nor does one UG's index has nothing for, whose
  // sites' marks say which site has what (``sites``).
  const statusOf = (s) => (SHOWS.review(s) ? { kind: "review", text: "Needs review" }
    : s.notFound && s.status === "wanted" ? null
    : s.status === "found" ? null
    : { kind: s.status, text: label(STATUS_TEXT, s.status) || s.status });
  // What a song holds, for its line's glyphs (rows.js ``holds``), read from its files and its instruments: its sheet
  // (the auto one, when it has no other; UG's Ukulele Chords), a Guitar Pro file or else a text tab, a harmonica tab,
  // its lyrics and a score you filed.
  const holdingsOf = (s) => {
    const names = listOf(s.files).map((f) => String((f && f.name) || ""));
    const has = (pattern) => names.some((n) => pattern.test(n));
    const plays = (x) => listOf(s.instruments).indexOf(x) >= 0;
    const holds = [];
    if (s.auto === true) holds.push("auto");
    else if (has(/^sheet[.](html|pdf|txt|cho)$/)) holds.push(plays("ukulele") ? "ukulele" : "sheet");
    if (has(/^guitar-\d+[.]/)) holds.push("guitar");
    else if (names.indexOf("tab.txt") >= 0 || has(/^gametab-\d+[.]txt$/)) holds.push("tab");
    if (plays("harmonica")) holds.push("harmonica");
    if (has(/^lyrics[.](txt|lrc)$/)) holds.push("lyrics");
    if (plays("score")) holds.push("score");
    return holds;
  };
  // What a song has something for, as the Filter panel asks it (``inst=``, any of them): its closed line's holds,
  // read the same way: a chord sheet (the auto one, UG's Ukulele Chords), a guitar's (a Guitar Pro file or a text
  // tab), and, from its instruments, UG's Ukulele Chords, a harmonica tab and a score you filed.
  const INSTRUMENTS = ["sheet", "guitar", "ukulele", "harmonica", "score"];
  const instruments = new WeakMap();  // a song's data -> what it has something for, until the data changes
  const instOf = (s) => {
    if (!instruments.has(s)) {
      const holds = holdingsOf(s);
      const plays = listOf(s.instruments);
      const has = new Set();
      if (holds.some((h) => h === "sheet" || h === "auto" || h === "ukulele")) has.add("sheet");
      if (holds.indexOf("guitar") >= 0 || holds.indexOf("tab") >= 0) has.add("guitar");
      for (const x of ["ukulele", "harmonica", "score"]) if (plays.indexOf(x) >= 0) has.add(x);
      instruments.set(s, has);
    }
    return instruments.get(s);
  };
  // A list of them as the address writes it: the known ones, in the panel's order, each once.
  const instList = (names) => INSTRUMENTS.filter((x) => names.indexOf(x) >= 0).join(",");
  // Each as a tag names it, and as a sentence does ("with a harmonica tab or a score").
  const INST_TAG = { sheet: "Chord sheet", guitar: "Guitar tab", ukulele: "Ukulele", harmonica: "Harmonica",
    score: "Score" };
  const INST_SAID = { sheet: "a chord sheet", guitar: "a guitar tab", ukulele: "ukulele chords",
    harmonica: "a harmonica tab", score: "a score" };
  // A song's facts, under its line's chevron: the key in words and where it came from, the PDF's transposition, the
  // lyrics, when the song came, and its other artists.
  const factsOf = (s) => {
    const facts = el("p", "facts");
    if (typeof s.key === "string" && s.key) facts.appendChild(el("span", "key", keyText(s)));
    const shift = Number(s.transpose) || 0;
    if (shift) {
      const t = el("span", "transpose", (shift > 0 ? "+" : "−") + Math.abs(shift));
      t.title = "The PDF is transposed " + (shift > 0 ? "up " : "down ") + Math.abs(shift) +
        " semitone" + (Math.abs(shift) === 1 ? "" : "s");
      facts.appendChild(t);
    }
    if (label(LYRICS_TEXT, s.lyrics)) facts.appendChild(el("span", "lyrics", label(LYRICS_TEXT, s.lyrics)));
    if (s.added) facts.appendChild(el("span", "added", "Added " + String(s.added).slice(0, 10)));
    const others = listOf(s.artists).slice(1).map(String);
    if (others.length) facts.appendChild(el("span", "with", "With " + others.join(", ")));
    return facts.childNodes.length ? facts : null;
  };
  // Under a line's chevron: Select, the song picked, and its bar to put it in a songbook there is or a new one
  // (select.js, which hears "caracole:pick"). Select knows the songs the page was loaded with: a song new to the
  // library since (Get it, a request) has none until the page is loaded again, as it would do nothing.
  const bookButton = (s) => {
    const go = button("Add to a songbook…", "small", () => {
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("caracole:pick", { detail: { id: Number(s.id) } }));
    }, "Add " + String(s.title) + " by " + String(s.artist) + " to a songbook");
    go.prepend(glyph("book"));
    go.title = "Pick it, and any other songs, for a songbook";
    return go;
  };
  // A post of caracole serve's versions routes for a song, by its id (``action``: /versions/choose, /clear or
  // /keep-more), ``fields`` beside it; sent by the page's script, its request followed on the song's line.
  const versionsForm = (s, action, label, aria, title, fields) => {
    const form = songForm("versions-post", action, s);
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(fields || {})) form.appendChild(hidden(name, value));
    const go = el("button", "btn small", label);
    go.type = "submit";
    go.setAttribute("aria-label", aria);
    go.title = title;
    form.appendChild(go);
    postInPlace(form, go, s);
    return form;
  };
  // What a card's drawers do with a song's versions (card.js ``acts``), each made when its drawer opens. Served,
  // while no request of the song waits or runs (its line says how that goes) and it isn't ignored: Use this one
  // (``caracole versions --choose``, a [pin]), Back to caracole's pick (``--clear``), Fetch them (``--keep-more``,
  // "Fetch 6 more" when more are left than one lookup keeps), and LaCuerda's Use this one, the lookup that keeps
  // that LaCuerda sheet. From the file, which can ask nothing, the command that fetches the versions not kept.
  const drawerActs = (s) => {
    if (!server) return { keepMoreCommand: "caracole versions --keep-more " + shellNames(String(s.display)) };
    const id = Number(s.id);
    const title = String(s.title);
    const names = title + " by " + String(s.artist);
    const free = () => {
      const asked = jobOfSong(id);
      return s.status !== "ignored" && !removing.has(id) && !busy.has(id) && !(asked && isActive(asked));
    };
    return {
      choose: (v, ver) => (free() ? versionsForm(s, "/versions/choose", "Use this one", "Use " + ver + " of " + names,
        "Make it the sheet the title opens, as caracole versions --choose does: a [pin] in overrides.toml",
        { tab: String(v.tab) }) : null),
      clear: () => (free() ? versionsForm(s, "/versions/clear", "Back to caracole's pick",
        "Back to caracole's pick for " + names,
        "Take your choice out of [pin], as caracole versions --clear does: caracole picks the sheet again") : null),
      keepMore: (rest, n) => {
        if (!free() || !(n > 0)) return null;
        const some = n < rest;
        return versionsForm(s, "/versions/keep-more", some ? "Fetch " + n + " more" : "Fetch them",
          "Fetch " + (some ? n + " more versions" : rest === 1 ? "the version" : "the " + rest + " versions") + " of " +
          title + " from Ultimate Guitar",
          "Keeps them beside the sheet, one request each at a lookup's pace, as caracole versions --keep-more does");
      },
      useLaCuerda: (x, ver) => (free() ? lookupForm(s, "Use this one", "Use LaCuerda's " + ver + " of " + names,
        "Looks the song up now and keeps this LaCuerda sheet, as caracole get --lacuerda does", String(x.href)) : null),
    };
  };
  // A song's line: its title, then a button for each thing it holds to play from (card.js plays: its sheet, its Guitar
  // Pro file, its tab, its harmonica tab..., each opening it at once, none first), its status when it needs
  // something, its key, its main action (Fetch now's download icon, where it has one); and under its chevron, which
  // its title opens too, its card (card.js): its facts, then what needs you (its picker or what to do about its
  // match, where its audio comes from, a LaCuerda pick, Look in the index), what you play from it as tiles and their
  // versions' drawer, which sites have it, its progressions, where else to find it, and its foot (Fetch again, Use
  // LaCuerda's sheet, Add to a songbook…, info.json, Remove).
  const lineFor = (s) => {
    const id = Number(s.id);
    const more = [];
    const facts = factsOf(s);
    if (facts) more.push(facts);
    // The picker, or the note that says why there is none.
    const picker = SHOWS.review(s) && listOf(s.candidates).length > 0 ? makePicker(s) : null;
    if (picker) {
      // The line's button says Pick the match: its picker folds as a read-only one does, "3 candidates".
      const summary = picker.querySelector("summary");
      summary.className = "picker-open";
      summary.textContent = plural(listOf(s.candidates).filter((c) => c && c.ref).length, "candidate");
      more.push(picker);
    } else {
      const why = unpicked(s);
      if (why) more.push(why);
    }
    const fromYouTube = youtubeNote(s);
    if (fromYouTube) more.push(fromYouTube);
    const fromVideo = server ? youtubeSheet(s) : null;
    if (fromVideo) more.push(fromVideo);
    const picked = lacuerdaNote(s);
    if (picked) more.push(picked);
    if (server && s.notFound && s.status === "wanted" && !removing.has(id)) {
      const look = el("div", "actions");
      look.appendChild(lookLink(s, "btn small"));
      more.push(look);
    }
    // What you play from it, and every file a tile shows: the rest, any, a group of their own.
    const claimed = new Set();
    const shown = card.tiles(s, { guitar: Boolean(server && server.guitar), acts: drawerActs(s), claimed });
    if (shown) more.push(shown);
    const sites = card.sites(listOf(s.sites));  // which sites have it, had nothing, or weren't asked yet
    if (sites) more.push(sites);
    const info = listOf(s.files).find((f) => f && f.name === "info.json") || null;
    const others = listOf(s.files).filter((f) => f && !claimed.has(f) && f !== info);
    if (others.length) more.push({ heading: "Files", links: others });
    if (server && !server.guitar && listOf(s.files).some((f) => f && typeof f.guitarPage === "string" && f.guitarPage)) {
      more.push(el("p", "note", "caracole serve can show Guitar Pro files in the browser once it has alphaTab " +
        "(CARACOLE_ALPHATAB_DIR): until then they are downloads."));
    }
    const progs = progressionsOf(s);
    if (progs) more.push(progs);
    const elsewhere = card.findElsewhere([{ heading: "Find the chords", links: s.links },
      { heading: "Scores on MuseScore", links: s.museScore }, { heading: "Buy the track for an auto sheet", links: s.buy }]);
    if (elsewhere) more.push(elsewhere);
    const control = serverAction(s, picker);
    const action = control.held ? control.action : null;
    const asked = server ? jobOfSong(id) : null;
    const again = server && !removing.has(id) && !busy.has(id) && !(asked && isActive(asked)) ? againActions(s) : null;
    const foot = card.foot(s, { actions: [again], book: byIndex.has(id) ? bookButton(s) : null, info,
      remove: server && !removing.has(id) ? removeForm(s) : null });  // removing: its action says so
    if (foot) more.push(foot);
    const artists = listOf(s.artists);
    const keyed = typeof s.key === "string" && s.key;
    const status = statusOf(s);
    const line = resultRow({
      dense: true,
      title: shownName(s, s.title),
      plays: card.plays(s, { guitar: Boolean(server && server.guitar) }),  // a button each, right after the title
      artist: artists.length > 1 ? artists.join(", ") : shownName(s, s.artist),  // shown where no group names it
      status: s.status,
      key: keyed ? s.key : "",
      keyText: keyed ? keyText(s) : "",
      badges: status ? [status] : [],
      action,
      more,
      onArtist: () => {
        setArtist(String(s.sortArtist || ""));
        window.scrollTo(0, 0);
      },
      onSearch: server ? () => searchFor(String(s.artist)) : null,  // served, the name searches; the funnel filters
    });
    line.dataset.id = String(s.id);  // the Select mode finds the song's line by it
    // Its title opens its card as its chevron does, a tap's convenience (the chevron is the keyboard's); never one of
    // its buttons, which open what they hold. The line it is in by then (refill moves it into the line drawn before).
    const named = line.querySelector(":scope > .line-title");
    named.classList.add("opens-card");
    named.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      if (e.target.closest("a, button")) return;
      const more = e.currentTarget.parentNode && e.currentTarget.parentNode.querySelector(":scope > .line-more");
      if (more) more.click();
    });
    if (s.status === "found") line.classList.add("have");  // set apart among a search's results (rows.css)
    // How the song's request goes, on a line of its own, and its lookup's steps under it.
    const job = server ? jobOfSong(id) : null;
    if (job) {
      showRequest(line, job);
    } else if (server && s.status === "wanted" && !removing.has(id) && busy.has(id)) {
      showLine(progressIn(line), { line: { tone: "running", text: "Fetching…" } });
    }
    if (removals.has(id)) countdownIn(line, removals.get(id));  // drawn again while its removal counts down
    return line;
  };
  const lines = new Map();  // song index -> its line, made the first time it shows
  const lineOf = (i) => {
    if (!lines.has(i)) lines.set(i, lineFor(songs[i]));
    return lines.get(i);
  };
  // An artist's group: a header that names them and counts the songs of theirs you have, "Soda Stereo · you have
  // 2" (``counts.mine``: all of them, whatever the search or a filter leaves out), and, while the served page searches
  // the sites, the songs each site's index lists of theirs, "· UG 96 · LaCuerda 140 · Guitar Pro 12" (``counts.ug``,
  // ``counts.lacuerda``, ``counts.gtptabs``: gtptabs.com's; ``counts.note``, any other words); then their lines. Served,
  // the name searches for them (searchFor; not a group that names no artist, ``artist.search`` false: MuseScore's), and,
  // once you have songs of theirs, the funnel beside it shows those alone (``artist.filter``, their sortArtist, else
  // ``artist.key``); from a file, which can't search the sites, the name is the funnel's. An artist a search may have
  // meant (``artist.meant``, a typo's "Did you mean") says so to a screen reader, and their songs on the site that
  // names them come first in the counts (``counts.theirs``: "7 songs on UG").
  let groupSerial = 0;
  const artistGroup = (artist, items, counts) => {
    const a = artist && typeof artist === "object" ? artist : { name: artist };
    const name = String(a.name || "");
    const filter = String(own.call(a, "filter") ? a.filter : a.key || "");
    const c = counts && typeof counts === "object" ? counts : {};
    const mine = Number(c.mine) || 0;
    const section = el("section", a.meant ? "artist meant" : "artist");
    section.dataset.artist = String(a.key || "");
    section.tabIndex = -1;  // the A-Z strip moves the focus to it
    const heading = el("h2", "artist-title");
    groupSerial += 1;
    heading.id = "artist-" + groupSerial;

  // The artist part of a song's identity key: the header its line shares with the sites' rows of its artist.
  const artistKeyOf = (s) => String((s && s.identity) || "").split("/")[0] || "~" + String((s && s.sortArtist) || "");

  // The answer's artists and songs, put together by artist and by song, in the order the answer ranks them: the
  // removed songs it matches first (songs you had), then LaCuerda's artists and songs when it alone has the artist the
  // query names (``lacuerda_leads``), the artists the query names when one leads, Ultimate Guitar's songs, its
  // artists otherwise, LaCuerda's, gtptabs.com's songs, harptabs.com's artists and songs (by an artist whose page
  // caracole read); MuseScore's pages and harptabs.com's tabs whose artist no page names, titles alone, apart. An artist's group is
  // keyed by the artist part of its rows' identity keys (``artist_key``; an artist's ``group_key``), a row of a song of
  // yours by your song's artist (``song``, ``same_artist``) putting its artist's rows under your artist (UG's "Song

  const mergeSites = (data) => {

      ...ugArtists.flatMap((a) => objects(a.top)), ...lcArtists.flatMap((a) => objects(a.top)),

      ...objects(data.removed).map((r) => ["song", "removed", r]),
      ...(leads ? lacuerda : []),
      ...(data.lead === "artist" ? named : []),
      ...objects(data.index).map((h) => ["song", "ug", h]),
      ...(data.lead === "artist" ? [] : named),
      ...(leads ? [] : lacuerda),

      ...htArtists.map((a) => ["artist", "harptabs", a]),
      ...htSongs.map((h) => ["song", "harptabs", h]),
      ...objects(data.gametabs).map((h) => ["song", "gametabs", h]),  // gametabs.net's tracks, the game the artist
    ]) {

  const FOUND_SITES = ["ug", "gtptabs", "lacuerda", "harptabs", "gametabs"];

  const foundNothing = (model) => Boolean(model) && !Array.from(model.items.values()).some((item) => !item.meant) &&

  const yourSong = (row) => (row.song === null || row.song === undefined ? undefined : byIndex.get(Number(row.song)));

  const addArtist = (model, source, a) => {
    const g = groupOf(model, model.alias.get(String(a.group_key)) || String(a.group_key || ""), a.artist);
    if (!g[source]) g[source] = a;
    for (const t of objects(a.top)) addSong(model, source, t, g);
    if (source === "ug") g.ugListed = Math.max(g.ugListed, objects(a.top).length);
  };
  // A site's row of a song, on the song's item in its artist's group (``into``, for an artist's songs), made the first
  // time; an item drawn already is drawn again with it, unless its line shows a request.
  const addSong = (model, source, row, into) => {
    const i = yourSong(row);
    const g = i !== undefined ? groupOf(model, artistKeyOf(songs[i]), songs[i].artist)
      : into || groupOf(model, model.alias.get(String(row.artist_key)) || String(row.artist_key || ""), row.artist);
    const key = g.key + "/" + (i !== undefined ? titleKeyOf(songs[i]) : String(row.title_key || ""));
    let item = model.items.get(key);
    if (!item) {
      item = { key, mine: undefined, ug: null, lacuerda: null, gtptabs: null, harptabs: null, gametabs: null,
        removed: null };
      model.items.set(key, item);
      g.items.push(item);
    }
    if (i !== undefined) item.mine = i;
    if (i !== undefined && source === "lacuerda") offerLaCuerda(i, row);
    if (!item[source]) {
      item[source] = row;
      const drawn = model.lines.get(key);
      if (drawn && !drawn.querySelector(".progress")) model.lines.delete(key);
    }
    return item;
  };
  // A LaCuerda row of a song of yours, with chords: its line offers that sheet (Use LaCuerda's sheet), drawn again
  // now if it is drawn already and had none. Its chevron open, it stays open, and the focus on its button stays there.
  const offerLaCuerda = (i, row) => {
    const id = Number(songs[i].id);
    const https = (url) => /^https:[/][/]/i.test(String(url || ""));
    if (lacuerdaFound.has(id) || !https(row.sheet) || !https(row.url)) return;
    const before = lacuerdaOf(songs[i]);
    lacuerdaFound.set(id, String(row.url));
    if (!lines.has(i) || lacuerdaOf(songs[i]) === before) return;
    const old = lines.get(i);
    const more = old.querySelector(":scope > .line-more");
    const focused = Boolean(more && more === document.activeElement);
    const drawn = refill(old, lineFor(songs[i]));
    lines.set(i, drawn);
    const fresh = drawn.querySelector(":scope > .line-more");
    if (focused && fresh && fresh.isConnected) fresh.focus();
  };
  const lineOfItem = (model, item) => {
    if (!model.lines.has(item.key)) model.lines.set(item.key, indexLine(item, { get: getIt, later, again: addAgain }));
    return model.lines.get(item.key);
  };

  // An artist's group's foot, made once: "+ 57 more by Estopa" (the rest of their songs on Ultimate Guitar, fifty at a
  // time, from /api/artist), "+ 3 more by Estopa on LaCuerda" (the rest the index holds of theirs), the same on
  // harptabs.com, or, for an artist whose page caracole has never read there, the offer to read it; for an artist the
  // query may have meant, until their songs are listed, "Their 7 songs on UG ›" (openSuggested). None when there is
  // nothing more: null.
  const tailOf = (m) => {
    if (!m.tail) {
      m.tail = { box: el("div", "group-tail"), ug: null, lc: null, offer: null, ht: null, htOffer: null };
      if (m.meant && !m.ug && !m.lacuerda && !m.harptabs) {
        const model = answer.model;
        const s = m.meant;
        const go = button("Their " + songsOn(s), "small more-by their-songs", (e) => openSuggested(model, s,
          e.currentTarget));
        const arrow = el("span", "their-arrow", "›");
        arrow.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        go.appendChild(arrow);
        m.tail.box.appendChild(go);
      }
      if (m.ug) {
        m.tail.ug = button("", "small more-by", () => moreOf(m, "ug"));
        m.tail.box.appendChild(m.tail.ug);
      }
      if (m.lacuerda && Number(m.lacuerda.known) > 0) {
        m.tail.lc = button("", "small more-by", () => moreOf(m, "lacuerda"));
        m.tail.box.appendChild(m.tail.lc);
      } else if (m.lacuerda) {
        m.tail.offer = readOffer(m);
        m.tail.box.appendChild(m.tail.offer);
      }
      if (m.harptabs && Number(m.harptabs.known) > 0) {
        m.tail.ht = button("", "small more-by", () => moreOf(m, "harptabs"));
        m.tail.box.appendChild(m.tail.ht);
      } else if (m.harptabs && !m.harptabs.read) {  // a page read that lists no tab is offered no read again
        m.tail.htOffer = harpOffer(m);
        m.tail.box.appendChild(m.tail.htOffer);
      }
    }
    const listed = (source) => m.items.filter((item) => item[source]).length;
    const more = (go, left, text, aria) => {
      if (!go) return;
      if (left <= 0) {
        go.remove();
        return;
      }
      go.textContent = "+ " + left.toLocaleString("en") + " more by " + text;
      go.setAttribute("aria-label", aria(left));
    };
    more(m.tail.ug, Number(m.ug && m.ug.songs) - m.ugListed, m.name, (n) => "List " + n + " more songs by " + m.name +
      " on Ultimate Guitar");
    more(m.tail.lc, m.lcListed ? 0 : Number(m.lacuerda && m.lacuerda.known) - listed("lacuerda"), m.name + " on LaCuerda",
      (n) => "List " + n + " more songs by " + m.name + " on LaCuerda");
    more(m.tail.ht, m.htListed ? 0 : Number(m.harptabs && m.harptabs.held) - listed("harptabs"),
      m.name + " on harptabs.com", (n) => "List " + n + " more songs by " + m.name + " on harptabs.com");
    return m.tail.box.childNodes.length ? m.tail.box : null;
  };
  // "+ N more": the artist's next songs, in their group, each a line as the others are; the focus stays on the button,
  // or, once it is gone, goes to the first song it listed.
  const moreOf = (m, source) => {
    const was = answer;
    const go = source === "ug" ? m.tail.ug : source === "harptabs" ? m.tail.ht : m.tail.lc;
    const before = new Set(m.items);
    go.disabled = true;
    say("Listing " + m.name + "'s songs…");
    const listing = source === "ug" ? artistPage(String(m.ug.artist_key || ""), m.ugOffset)
      : source === "harptabs" ? sitePage({ harptabs: String(m.harptabs.path || "") })
      : sitePage({ slug: String(m.lacuerda.slug || "") });
    listing.then((page) => {
      go.disabled = false;
      if (!page || answer !== was || !state.all) return;
      const got = objects(page.songs);
      if (source === "ug") {
        for (const h of got) addSong(was.model, "ug", h, m).meant = false;  // listed now: found, no guess
        m.ugOffset += got.length;
        m.ugListed = got.length ? Math.max(m.ugListed, m.ugOffset) : Number(m.ug.songs);
        say(m.name + ": " + many(page.total, "song") + " on Ultimate Guitar");
      } else if (source === "harptabs") {
        listHarptabs(m, page);
      } else {
        listLaCuerda(m, page);
      }
      drawGroups();
      const first = m.items.find((item) => !before.has(item));
      const line = first ? (first.mine !== undefined ? lines.get(first.mine) : was.model.lines.get(first.key)) : null;
      if (go.isConnected) go.focus();
      else if (line && line.isConnected) line.focus();
    });
  };
  // A LaCuerda artist's songs the index holds (/api/artist?lacuerda=), all of them, in their group.
  const listLaCuerda = (m, page) => {
    for (const h of objects(page.songs)) addSong(answer.model, "lacuerda", h, m).meant = false;
    m.lcListed = true;
    if (m.tail && m.tail.offer) {
      m.tail.offer.remove();
      m.tail.offer = null;
    }
    say(String(page.artist) + ": " + many(page.total, "song") + " on LaCuerda");
  };
  // A harptabs.com artist's songs the index holds (/api/artist?harptabs=), all of them, in their group.
  const listHarptabs = (m, page) => {
    for (const h of objects(page.songs)) addSong(answer.model, "harptabs", h, m).meant = false;
    m.htListed = true;
    if (m.tail && m.tail.htOffer) {
      m.tail.htOffer.remove();
      m.tail.htOffer = null;
    }
    say(String(page.artist) + ": " + many(objects(page.songs).length, "song") + " on harptabs.com");
  };
  // A harptabs.com artist whose page caracole has never read: the button that reads it (a request, a job of its own),
  // then lists their songs in their group.
  const harpOffer = (m) => {
    const name = String(m.harptabs.artist || m.name);
    const box = el("div", "read-page");
    box.appendChild(el("p", null, "caracole hasn't read the page of " + name + " on harptabs.com yet. Reading it is one " +
      "request to harptabs.com, at a lookup's pace."));
    box.appendChild(button("Read their page", "small primary", (e) => readThenShow(
      { harptabs: String(m.harptabs.path || "") }, e.currentTarget, box, (page) => {
        listHarptabs(m, page);
        drawGroups();
      }), "Read the page of " + name + " on harptabs.com"));
    return box;
  };
  // An artist whose page caracole has never read: how many songs LaCuerda lists, and the button that reads it (a
  // request, a job of its own), then lists them in their group.
  const readOffer = (m) => {
    const name = String(m.lacuerda.artist || m.name);
    const box = el("div", "read-page");
    box.appendChild(el("p", null, "caracole hasn't read the page of " + name + " on LaCuerda yet, which lists " +
      many(m.lacuerda.songs, "song") + ". Reading it is one request to LaCuerda, at a lookup's pace."));
    box.appendChild(button("Read their page", "small primary", (e) => readThenShow({ slug: String(m.lacuerda.slug || "") },
      e.currentTarget, box, (page) => {
        listLaCuerda(m, page);
        drawGroups();
      }), "Read the page of " + name + " on LaCuerda"));
    return box;
  };
  // A name LaCuerda's index has no artist by, read by that name (Ask LaCuerda, under the groups or on the card of a
  // search that found nothing): their group, first; Ask LaCuerda gone.
  const readByName = (model) => (page) => {
    const g = groupOf(model, String(page.group_key || ""), page.artist);
    g.lacuerda = { artist: page.artist, slug: page.slug, songs: page.listed, known: page.total, gtptabs: page.gtptabs };
    model.order.splice(model.order.indexOf(g.key), 1);
    model.order.unshift(g.key);
    listLaCuerda(g, page);
    model.unlisted = null;
    model.card = model.line = undefined;
    drawGroups();
  };
  // An artist the answer suggests ("Did you mean Lynyrd Skynyrd?"), or the artist of a song it does, opened: their
  // songs (/api/artist, fifty, or those LaCuerda's or harptabs.com's index holds, or the offer to read their page), in
  // their group, first, as an artist the query names is; the focus to it. It reads the indexes alone: no site is asked
  // anything.
  const openSuggested = (model, s, go) => {
    const was = answer;
    const ug = s.source !== "lacuerda" && s.source !== "harptabs";
    go.disabled = true;
    say("Listing " + String(s.artist || "") + "'s songs…");
    const listing = ug ? artistPage(String(s.artist_key || ""), 0)
      : sitePage(s.source === "harptabs" ? { harptabs: String(s.path || "") } : { slug: String(s.slug || "") });
    listing.then((page) => {
      go.disabled = false;
      if (!page || answer !== was || !state.all) return;
      const g = groupOf(model, model.alias.get(String(s.group_key)) || String(s.group_key || ""), page.artist);
      g.tail = null;  // made again, with what this group has now
      if (ug) {
        const got = objects(page.songs);
        g.ug = { artist_key: page.artist_key, artist: page.artist, songs: page.total, tabs: page.tabs,
          group_key: s.group_key, top: [] };
        for (const h of got) addSong(model, "ug", h, g).meant = false;  // listed now: found, no guess
        g.ugOffset = got.length;
        g.ugListed = got.length;
        say(String(page.artist) + ": " + many(page.total, "song") + " on Ultimate Guitar");
      } else if (s.source === "harptabs") {
        g.harptabs = { artist: page.artist, path: page.path, songs: page.listed, known: page.total,
          held: objects(page.songs).length, read: page.read };
        if (page.read) listHarptabs(g, page);
      } else {
        g.lacuerda = { artist: page.artist, slug: page.slug, songs: page.listed, known: page.total, gtptabs: page.gtptabs };
        if (page.read) listLaCuerda(g, page);
      }
      model.order.splice(model.order.indexOf(g.key), 1);
      model.order.unshift(g.key);
      drawGroups();
      const section = Array.from(groupsBox.querySelectorAll("section.artist")).find((x) => x.dataset.artist === g.key);
      if (section) section.focus();
    });
  };

  // Of your songs, those the filters show (the Filter panel's and the artist's), in the list as in the results (the
  // sites' songs are what the sites have, whatever they show); and that in words, for the results' head, which hides
  // the toolbar: "Your songs here: wanted · by Soda Stereo · with a harmonica tab · in A minor", or nothing when they
  // show every song.
  const kept = (i) => (!state.artist || String(songs[i].sortArtist || "") === state.artist) &&
    keyFits(i) && (!state.prog || playsProg(songs[i], state.prog)) && instFits(i) && SHOWS[state.show](songs[i]);
  const SHOW_WORD = { found: "found", wanted: "wanted", review: "needing review" };
  const keptSaid = () => {
    const parts = [label(SHOW_WORD, state.show), state.artist ? "by " + artistName(state.artist) : "",
      state.inst ? "with " + instsChosen().map((x) => INST_SAID[x]).join(" or ") : "",
      keyChosen() ? "in " + keySaid() : "",
      state.prog ? "with " + progNumerals(state.prog) : ""].filter(Boolean);
    return parts.length ? "Your songs here: " + parts.join(" · ") : "";
  };
  // Show all of yours: every status, instrument, key, artist and progression, here and in the list; the focus to the
  // box, as the button goes with its note.
  const keptNote = el("p", "filtered");
  keptNote.append(el("span"), button("Show all of yours", "small", () => {
    clearFilters();
    state.prog = "";
    render();
    save();
    input.focus();
  }, "Show all of yours: every status, instrument, key, artist and progression"));
  keptNote.hidden = true;
  // A progression typed or named (/api/search's ``progression``: "vi IV I V", "andalusian"): how many of your songs
  // play it, and Show them, the list of those songs alone (#prog=). The first few are among the results already.
  const progNote = el("p", "filtered prog-found");
  progNote.hidden = true;
  const drawProgFound = () => {
    const p = answer && answer.q === normal(state.q) && answer.data.progression &&
      typeof answer.data.progression === "object" ? answer.data.progression : null;
    const key = p && typeof p.key === "string" ? p.key : "";
    const said = key ? String(p.label || progLabel(key)) + (p.name && p.name !== p.label ? ", " + String(p.name) : "") : "";
    progNote.hidden = !key;
    if (progNote.dataset.said === said + "|" + String(p && p.songs)) return;
    progNote.dataset.said = said + "|" + String(p && p.songs);
    progNote.replaceChildren();
    if (!key) return;
    const n = Number(p.songs) || 0;
    if (!n) {
      progNote.append("None of your songs play " + said + " yet");
      return;
    }
    progNote.append(el("span", null, "Your songs with " + said + ": " + n),
      button("Show them", "small", () => setProg(key), "Show your " + plural(n, "song") + " with " + said));
  };

  // What the results show now: your songs that match what is typed and that the buttons show (not one removed since
  // the page loaded: the answer has it as removed, with Add again), then the server's close matches the filter missed
  // (MINE_SHOWN in all, then All N of your songs), and the answer's groups, under one header
  // an artist: yours first, A to Z, then the answer's, in its order. A song of yours is its own line, with all it
  // offers, wherever the answer has it, unless the buttons hide it; a song of the sites, an index line (indexLine),
  // the same node from one draw to the next while the answer stands, so that what it shows stays. The focus stays
  // where it was as they are drawn again, a newer answer's too (LaCuerda's search's end brings one): on the same
  // node; else, from a line (Enter's, or Tab's), on the line of the same song, else on the first line.
  const drawGroups = () => {
    const had = groupsBox.contains(document.activeElement) ? document.activeElement : null;
    const hadLine = had ? had.closest("article") : null;
    const hadHit = hadLine ? String(hadLine.dataset.hit || "") : "";
    const model = answer && answer.model;
    const q = normal(state.q);
    const fits = typedMatch(parseQuery(state.q));
    const local = ORDERS.artist.filter((i) => counted(songs[i]) && fits(i) && kept(i));
    const close = answer && answer.q === q ? listOf(answer.data.library).map((h) => byIndex.get(Number(h && h.id)))
      .filter((i) => i !== undefined && kept(i) && local.indexOf(i) < 0) : [];
    const mine = local.concat(close);
    const shown = mine.slice(0, MINE_SHOWN);
    const groups = new Map();
    const at = (key) => {
      if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, { mine: [], model: null });
      return groups.get(key);
    };
    if (model) for (const key of model.meant) at(key);  // the artists it may have meant, first
    for (const i of shown) at(artistKeyOf(songs[i])).mine.push(i);
    if (model) for (const key of model.order) at(key).model = model.groups.get(key);
    const yours = new Map();  // how many songs of each artist you have, the songs the search leaves out too
    const named = new Map();  // a song of each artist you have, which names them and filters by them
    for (const s of songs.concat(Array.from(arrived.values())).filter(counted)) {
      yours.set(artistKeyOf(s), (yours.get(artistKeyOf(s)) || 0) + 1);
      if (!named.has(artistKeyOf(s))) named.set(artistKeyOf(s), s);
    }
    const drawn = new Set(shown);
    const keys = new Set(shown.map((i) => String(songs[i].identity || "")));
    const box = document.createDocumentFragment();
    for (const [key, g] of groups) {
      const items = [];
      const theirs = g.mine.slice();
      for (const item of g.model ? g.model.items : []) {
        if (item.mine !== undefined) {
          if (!drawn.has(item.mine) && kept(item.mine)) {
            drawn.add(item.mine);
            theirs.push(item.mine);
          }
        } else if (!keys.has(item.key)) {
          items.push(lineOfItem(model, item));
        }
      }
      const tail = g.model ? tailOf(g.model) : null;
      if (!theirs.length && !items.length && !tail) continue;
      const you = theirs.length ? songs[theirs[0]] : named.get(key) || null;
      const ug = (g.model && g.model.ug) || {};  // the artists the query names there, if any
      const lc = (g.model && g.model.lacuerda) || {};
      const ht = (g.model && g.model.harptabs) || {};
      const meant = (g.model && g.model.meant) || null;  // an artist it may have meant: their songs counted till listed
      const section = artistGroup({ key, name: you ? shownName(you, you.artist) : g.model.name,
        filter: you ? you.sortArtist : "", meant: Boolean(meant) },
        [...theirs.map(lineOf), ...items], { mine: yours.get(key) || 0, ug: ug.songs, lacuerda: lc.songs,
          gtptabs: Math.max(Number(ug.gtptabs) || 0, Number(lc.gtptabs) || 0), harptabs: ht.songs,
          theirs: meant && !g.model.ug && !g.model.lacuerda && !g.model.harptabs && Number(meant.songs)
            ? songsOn(meant) : "" });
      if (tail) section.appendChild(tail);
      box.appendChild(section);
    }
    if (model && model.titles.length) {  // MuseScore's pages: a title alone, no artist to put them under
      if (!model.titleLines) model.titleLines = model.titles.map(titleLine);
      box.appendChild(artistGroup({ name: "MuseScore", search: false }, model.titleLines,
        { note: many(model.titles.length, "page") + " by that title" }));
    }
    if (model && model.harps.length) {  // harptabs.com's harmonica tabs: a title alone too
      if (!model.harpLines) model.harpLines = model.harps.map(titleLine);
      box.appendChild(artistGroup({ name: "harptabs.com", search: false }, model.harpLines,
        { note: many(model.harps.length, "harmonica tab") + " by that title" }));
    }
    const missed = foundNothing(model);
    const missWas = groupsBox.querySelector(":scope > section.nothing");
    if (missed) box.appendChild(missOf(model, missWas));  // nothing on the sites: a line of the list, last
    groupsBox.replaceChildren(box);
    groupsBox.hidden = !groupsBox.childNodes.length;  // no empty box: nothing matches yet
    // One Request: what found nothing has its own, in its line, so the form under the results waits for it; and no
    // Back to your songs, as the box's × and Escape go back.
    results.classList.toggle("missed", missed);
    if (backButton) backButton.hidden = missed;
    if (had && !groupsBox.contains(document.activeElement)) {
      const lines = Array.from(groupsBox.querySelectorAll("article"));
      const miss = missWas && missWas.contains(had) ? groupsBox.querySelector(":scope > section.nothing") : null;
      const same = miss ? Array.from(miss.querySelectorAll(had.tagName)).find((x) => x.className === had.className)
        : null;  // the same control of what found nothing, drawn again: Ask LaCuerda, its chevron, Request
      const back = groupsBox.contains(had) ? had : same ? same
        : hadLine ? (hadHit && lines.find((a) => String(a.dataset.hit || "") === hadHit)) || lines[0] : null;
      if (back) back.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
    allMine.replaceChildren();
    if (mine.length > MINE_SHOWN) {
      allMine.appendChild(button("All " + mine.length + " of your songs", "small", () => leaveAll(true)));
    }
    allMine.hidden = !allMine.childNodes.length;
    drawCounts(mine.length);
    const said = keptSaid();
    if (keptNote.firstChild.textContent !== said) keptNote.firstChild.textContent = said;
    keptNote.hidden = !said;
    drawProgFound();
    notesBox.replaceChildren(...(model && !missed ? notesOf(model) : []));
  };
  // What the search says beside its results (rows.js), each made once an answer, Ask LaCuerda's state kept from one
  // draw to the next. Ask LaCuerda is the one LaCuerda button: it sends LaCuerda's search while its gate lets one go
  // by hand (the searcher's ``ask``), else reads the name's page.
  const saysOf = (model) => {
    const q = answer.q;
    return {
      data: Object.assign({}, answer.data, { lacuerda_unlisted: model.unlisted }),
      does: {
        dense: true,
        request: requestByName,
        ask: (go, box) => {
          if (searcher && searcher.ask(q, go)) return;
          readThenShow({ name: String(model.unlisted.name || "") }, go, box, readByName(model));
        },
      },
    };
  };
  // A query that found nothing on the sites: a line of the list under a quiet band (nothingFound), the query, where
  // caracole looked, Request where a song's Open is; its chevron has Ask LaCuerda, for a name under a letter its
  // listings don't reach yet, and why it may not see an artist. Drawn again for the same query (LaCuerda's search
  // over, say), its chevron stays as it was (``was``, the line before).
  const missOf = (model, was) => {
    if (!model.card) {
      const says = saysOf(model);
      const open = Boolean(was && was.dataset.query === answer.q && was.querySelector('.line-more[aria-expanded="true"]'));
      model.card = nothingFound(says.data, answer.q, Object.assign(says.does, { unfolded: open }));
    }
    return model.card;

  // A YouTube video suggested for a search with no sheet on the sites (web/youtube_routes.py): /api/search's

  const ytRow = (video, q) => {

      img.height = 90;

    said.setAttribute("role", "status");

    const again = () => {

    const over = () => {
      ytRunning = "";
      if (ytBox.contains(said)) ytBox.replaceChildren();
      again();

      body: new URLSearchParams({ csrf: String(server.csrf || ""), q }) })
      .then((r) => r.json().catch(() => null).then((data) => ({ ok: r.ok, data })))

          .then((job) => {

  };
  const ytFire = () => {

      return;

    ytWaiting = null;
    ytSend(w.gate, w.q);
  };
  const ytShow = (gate, q) => {
    if (!ytShownAt.has(q)) ytShownAt.set(q, performance.now());

    if (!g) return null;

    if (ytRunning && ytRunning === g.key) return ytBox.firstChild;

      ytTimer = setTimeout(ytFire, YT_SETTLE);
    }

  };
  // Enter, the query's answer on the screen: its YouTube search at once, when the answer says it may go.
  const ytEnter = (q) => {
    const g = answer && answer.q === q && answer.data ? answer.data.youtube : null;
    if (!server || !g || typeof g !== "object" || g.state !== "auto" || ytSent.has(String(g.key)) || ytRunning) return;
